items.text: Ὁ κόσμος εἶναι μηχανὴ ἀλληλοπαθῶν ῥευμάτων, ἣ οὐ κινεῖται διὰ ἐξωτερικῆς ὤσεως ἀλλὰ διὰ ἐσωτερικῶν σχέσεων.
Τὸ σῶμα εἶναι προσωρινὸς κόμβος, ὅπου ἡ ἑτερότης τρέφει τὴν ὁμοιότητα, ἡ δὲ ἐξασθένησις λύει τὸν κόμβον.
Ὁ ζῶν ὑποκείμενος δὲν εἶναι κύριος ἔξωθεν τῶν ῥοῶν, ἀλλὰ ἐνεργὸς τόπος ἀφομοιώσεως, ἀναλογίας καὶ ἀντιστάσεως.
Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι λύσις ἐν κινήσει· δὲν ἀφαιρεῖ ἁπλῶς τὴν ζωήν, ἀλλὰ μεταβάλλει τὴν ἰσορροπίαν μεταξὺ ἐσωτερικῆς καὶ ἐξωτερικῆς δυνάμεως.
Ἡ δυνατὴ ἐλευθερία ἔγκειται οὐχὶ εἰς ἔξοδον ἐκ τῆς ὕλης, ἀλλ’ εἰς διατήρησιν λόγου, συγγενείας καὶ ἀναλογίας ἐντὸς τῆς ῥοῆς.
Οἱ παρόντες ἀξονικοὶ νόμοι ἀρκοῦσι πρὸς ἀνασύστασιν τῆς κοινῆς λογικῆς ἀπὸ τὴν κίνησιν μέχρι τὴν νόσον καὶ τὴν λύσιν.
Ὑποκαθορίζονται ἡ ἀκριβὴς μηχανικὴ μετάβασις εἰς ἡδονήν, ἡ φύσις τῶν ψυχικῶν δεσμῶν καὶ ἡ ἀκριβὴς σχέσις τῶν στοιχείων πρὸς ἕκαστον νόσημα.
Ἡ ἀρχιτεκτονικὴ εἶναι συνεκτικωτάτη ὅπου ἡ αἰτιότης ἀκολουθεῖ ῥοὰς, γενέσεις, ἀναλογίας καὶ ἀναστροφάς.
Ἡ ἀνασύστασις ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ τὴν διατήρησιν τῆς γενετικῆς ἀκολουθίας, ἐπειδὴ ἡ σημασία παράγεται ἐκ μεταβάσεων καὶ οὐχὶ ἐκ μεμονωμένων ἀξιωμάτων.
Ἡ ἀξιωματικὴ συμπίεσις διασώζει τὸν μηχανισμόν, ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐξαντλεῖ τὰς ἐνδιάμεσους λεπτομερείας οὔτε τὴν ἄρρητον γέφυραν ἀπὸ φυσικῆς κινήσεως εἰς ποιοτικὴν ἐμπειρίαν.
The system seeks the explanation of bodily affections not in external forces, but in movements, mixtures, and changes of positions.
The apparent unity of natural, sensory, and biological phenomena is reconstructed as a network of mutually affecting movements.
Similarity and kinship transform otherness into harmony, assimilation, and bodily cohesion.
Life is a balance of inflow and outflow, maintained only through continuous transformations.
Time and repetition transform assimilative power into decline, old age, and dissolution of bonds.
Disease appears as a reversal of natural generation, whenever proportion, place, or the succession of compositions is disturbed.
The movement of the account is cumulative and recurrent; the cosmic, bodily, sensory, and pathological are read through the same generative line.
The conclusion does not lie in an immobile foundation, but in a principle that returns decay to the reversal of generation and the dissolution of bonds.
[Persistent] Every affection must be sought from movements, changes of positions, and relations of composition.
[Persistent] Similarity produces concord, whereas dissimilarity produces discord, both in sensation and in body.
[Mutating] The mixture and apprehension of swift and slow motions transform many movements into one affection or one new composition.
[Emergent] The body is not an aggregate of unconnected parts, but an active sequence of flows, bonds, and generations.
[Persistent] Every kindred thing is borne toward its kindred, and nourishment can become body only through assimilation.
[Persistent] Life is held together through the proportion of inflow and outflow, which regulates replenishment, growth, and decline.
[Mutating] Bodily identity is produced through continuous replenishment and transformation, not through an unchanging core.
[Emergent] Time and struggles diminish the strength of internal bonds and turn the assimilative relation toward decay.
[Emergent] The body is constituted hierarchically, from the first elements into marrow, bones, flesh, sinews, and blood.
[Mutating] Generation and decay are not incompatible poles, but decay is generated from the reversal of generation.
[Attractor] Natural order is defined through kinship, ratio, place, proportion, and generative succession.
[Terminal] Death is dissolution of bonds, but dissolution according to nature is distinguished from violent and unnatural interruption.
Movement recurs from natural phenomena to respiration, nourishment, growth, and disease, but changes its field of application.
Mixture initially signifies the production of sensible qualities, but afterward becomes a mechanism of assimilation and bodily constitution.
Harmony shifts from concord of tones to embodied proportion, which can be called health or pleasure.
Kinship migrates from cosmic motion to a process of nutritional assimilation and preservation of identity.
Flow ceases to signify movement alone and becomes the measure of life, health, growth, and decay.
Generation acquires an inverse form: when natural succession is dissolved, the same mechanism becomes a bearer of dissolution.
External cause yields to internal disorder, inability to assimilate, and reversal of compositions.
Triangular bonds remain a local mechanism, but are absorbed into a more general principle of temporal weakening and dissolution.
Death ceases to mean a single end and becomes a difference of modes of dissolution, natural or violent.
Attraction and the void perform a negative role, but later disappear as independent explanatory mechanisms.
The precise function of electrons, Heraclean stones, triangles, and biles remains local; these are specifications, not the universal core.
Movement, kinship, proportion, assimilation, and generative succession are scaled up to the present level.
The bridge between the units becomes the idea that bodily affection, health, and disease are different phases of the same kinetic order.
The catalyst of transition is the transfer of cosmic motion into the body's internal distribution.
The principle surpassing the local is that nourishment becomes body only through transformation and assimilation, not through simple addition.
Simple external attraction is replaced by a network of internal relations, flows, and changes of place.
The present level produces an architecture that no unit alone can express: the sequence movement → assimilation → constitution → decay.
Attraction as an independent cause is rejected, because phenomena are generated from connected movements.
The void as an external mechanism is rejected, because movement is explained through continuous interweaving.
Inert matter, awaiting external action, is excluded, because all matter is subject to kinship, division, and motion.
Bodily identity as an immobile core is excluded, because existence is held together through continuous replenishments.
Disease as an inexplicable accident is excluded, because pathology constitutes a deviation from natural generation.
The distinction between natural and sensory is weakened when both are produced from movements and relations.
Death as one undifferentiated event is excluded, because the manner of dissolution determines its affection and value.
The hypothesis that movement is imposed from without must be false, because causality is constituted in the relation of things moved.
The hypothesis that an affection is a simple transfer of a thing must be false, because it comes to be from the relation of movements.
The hypothesis that the body is maintained by simple addition must be false, because nourishment must be transformed into likeness.
The hypothesis that health is static immobility must be false, because its preservation requires flow and ratio.
The hypothesis that generation and decay are unconnected must be false, because the latter arises from the reversal of the former.
The hypothesis that soul and body are absolutely separated must be false, because the dissolution of bodily bonds leaves the psychic bonds.
There is no inert, unchanging, and indifferent substrate lying beneath all changes.
A world divided into unconnected natural, biological, and sensory fields is excluded, because the same kinetic line runs through all things.
There is no equilibrium without movement; duration always conceals replenishment, weakening, or dissolution.
The complete reduction of the qualitative to mechanical movement remains impossible, because the transition toward pleasure and delight preserves an ineffable gap.
Bodily physiology constitutes a miniature of cosmic movement, because internal motion imitates universal motion.
The assimilation of nourishment and the mixture of elements are one common form of transforming the dissimilar into likeness.
Health is not the preservation of an unchanging form, but the successful regulation of transformations, which preserves identity through change.
Old age is the temporal transition from active assimilation to the predominance of external division.
Disease is a pathological reversal of assimilation: what ought to constitute becomes a bearer of dissolution.
The difference between natural death and disease follows the difference between orderly dissolution and reversed generation.
The unity of the body is produced as a genealogical chain, in which the disturbance of one level extends to others.
Harmony, health, and pleasure share the type of concordant movement, but the transition from mechanism to quality remains open.
The cosmos and the body appear as homologous circuits, in which motion, filling, change, and dissolution are reproduced across scales.
Causality is transformed from external impulse into a genealogy of changes, where each affection becomes the principle of another.
Life is a mechanism for taming otherness, because external matter becomes internal likeness.
Pathology is the moment at which the transformation of otherness into likeness is reversed and matter imposes itself upon the body.
Time is not merely a measure, but an active factor in the weakening of bonds and the alteration of the relation to matter.
The soul becomes dependent on bodily cohesion, but is not simply identical with the body; the relation remains one of bonds and transition.
Explanation replaces the names of phenomena with sequences of generation, proportion, transformation, and reversal.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Emptying → entry of kindred matter → assimilation → replenishment → new emptying; life is held together as a recurrent necessity.
Similarity → concord → harmonious affection → preservation of natural order; harmony becomes mechanism and criterion.
Replenishment → growth → weakening of bonds → old age → dissolution; the initial circuit of life already contains its end.
Natural generation → composition → function; when the succession is reversed, composition becomes disease and function decay.
Cosmic motion → internal motion → local assimilation → reproduction of cosmic order; the small repeats the great.
Rejection of attraction and void → interweaving of movements → universal kinetic causality; negation becomes a positive mechanism.
Natural order functions as the system's attractive pole: every deviation is defined by its distance from ratio, place, and kinship.
The repetition of movement does not signify identity; it signifies a phase-transition, when assimilation becomes decay or generation reversal.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Phenomenon → rejection of the surface cause → search for movements and relations.
Movement → similarity or dissimilarity → concord or discord → sensible affection.
Emptiness → entry of kindred matter → division and assimilation → replenishment of the body.
First elements → secondary compositions → blood and flows → dynamic bodily identity.
Inflow and outflow → proportion → growth or decline → weakening of bonds → old age and dissolution.
Reverse generation → altered composition → displacement and discord → disease and decay.
The overall mechanism produces qualities and affections from sequences of transformation, not from unconnected principles.

sections.original_name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Phenomena of attraction, flow, and sensation → rejection of attraction, void, and simple impulse → network of movements.
Network of movements → kinship and mixture → respiration, nourishment, harmony, and bodily replenishment.
Replenishment → assimilative division → growth or decline → temporal change of bodily power.
Temporal weakening → dissolution of triangular and psychic bonds → distinction between natural death and violent decay.
Disease → elemental irregularity → reversal of generation → internal diffusion of decay → reclassification of pathology.
Kinetic causality → bodily assimilation → dynamic health → generation of old age and disease → natural or violent dissolution.
The sharp division of natural, biological, and sensory is dissolved, because all are subject to a common generative mobility.
The body is reclassified as a flowing and genealogical unity, not as a closed aggregate of organs.
Nutrition is elevated into a cosmological process, in which external matter is transformed into internal likeness.
Health appears as a regulated proportion of flows, while disease appears as a measurable deviation of place, quantity, and generative succession.
Death is separated from the unified meaning of an end and becomes a typology of dissolutions, corresponding to cause.
The reading of phenomena requires the search for a generative sequence, not acceptance of the surface of names.
Decay is shifted from a final result to an internal reversal of the process that constitutes the body.
At the surface level, tones, flows, respiration, nourishment, blood, growth, old age, and disease are integrated into one sequence.
At the structural level, phenomena are constituted by movements, flows, kinship, compositions, bonds, and changes of place.
At the metastrategic level, explanation shifts attention from symptom to generative sequence and its reversal.
At the ontological and temporal level, being exists as a temporary composition within enduring movement, which time weakens.
At the methodological and performative level, the sequence of the account itself imitates the object: it analyzes, connects, transforms, and reverses.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Harmony is explained mechanically as concord of movements, but the transition from mixture to pleasure remains underdetermined.
The soul is necessarily connected with bodily bonds, but is not fully reduced to bodily structure.
Natural dissolution is characterized as pleasant, while the natural process necessarily leads to weakening and death; the evaluative bridge remains unstable.
Cosmic proportion requires order, but its temporal duration produces inevitable weakening; stability exists only as transitory regulation.
Movement mutates into flow, flow into assimilation, and assimilation into a criterion of identity.
Harmony mutates from a sensory relation into a natural ratio of health and pathology.
Generation mutates into its opposite when the natural sequence is reversed and becomes a mechanism of decay.
The reference of biological motion to cosmic motion transforms the body from a particular being into a local version of a universal mechanism.
“According to nature” shifts from a descriptive concept to an evaluative criterion when natural dissolution is called pleasant.

sections.original_name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: The cosmos is a machine of mutually affecting flows, moved not by external impulse but by internal relations.
The body is a temporary node, where otherness nourishes likeness, while weakening dissolves the node.
The living subject is not a master outside the flows, but an active locus of assimilation, proportion, and resistance.
Time is dissolution in motion; it does not merely remove life, but alters the balance between internal and external power.
Possible freedom lies not in an exit from matter, but in maintaining ratio, kinship, and proportion within the flow.
The present axial laws suffice for reconstructing the common logic from movement as far as disease and dissolution.
The precise mechanical transition to pleasure, the nature of psychic bonds, and the precise relation of the elements to each disease are underdetermined.
The architecture is most coherent where causality follows flows, generations, proportions, and reversals.
Reconstruction depends on preserving the generative sequence, because meaning is produced from transitions and not from isolated axioms.
Axiomatic compression preserves the mechanism, but does not exhaust the intermediate details or the ineffable bridge from natural movement to qualitative experience.
Τὸ κεντρικὸν πρόβλημα εἶναι πῶς ἡ φυσικὴ ῥύθμισις τῶν ὑγρῶν, τῶν ἱστῶν καὶ τῶν διεξόδων μετατρέπεται εἰς παθολογικὴν ἀναστροφήν.
Ἡ ἐξήγησις μετατοπίζει τὴν νόσον ἀπὸ τὸ μεμονωμένον σύμπτωμα εἰς τὰς ἀλληλεπιδράσεις ῥοῆς, μίξεως, θρέψεως, ἀναπνοῆς καὶ δεσμοῦ.
Ἡ τοπικὴ βλάβη γίνεται ἀλυσὶς μεταδόσεως, ἣ διὰ τῶν ἱστῶν καὶ τοῦ αἵματος ἐπεκτείνεται εἰς τὸ σύνολον τοῦ σώματος.
Ἡ φυσικὴ τάξις δὲν σημαίνει ἀκινησίαν, ἀλλὰ ρυθμισμένην κυκλοφορίαν ἣ διατηρεῖ μέτρον μεταξὺ λεπτότητος, πάχους, θερμότητος καὶ ψύξεως.

Ἡ κίνησις τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι σπειροειδής: ἡ διατάραξις παράγει νέαν διατάραξιν, ἡ δὲ κυκλοφορία τῆς νοσηρᾶς ὕλης ἐνισχύει τὴν ἀρχικὴν βλάβην.

[Persistent] Ἡ φυσικὴ τάξις εἶναι ῥυθμισμένη ῥοή, οὐχὶ ἀκινησία ἢ ἁπλὴ παρουσία ὕλης.
[Emergent] Ἡ νόσος γεννᾶται ὅταν ἀποτύχῃ ὁ μετασχηματισμός, ὥστε ἡ τροφή, ἡ ἀναπνοή, ἡ ῥοὴ ἢ ἡ θερμότης νὰ στραφῶσιν ἐναντίον τοῦ σώματος.
[Emergent] Ἡ τοπικὴ παθολογία κλιμακοῦται διὰ μεταδόσεως ἀπὸ ἱστὸν εἰς ἱστόν, ἀπὸ ὀστοῦν εἰς σάρκα, καὶ ἀπὸ σάρκα εἰς αἷμα.
[Mutating] Ἡ τροφή καὶ ἡ ἀναπνοὴ εἶναι διτταὶ δίοδοι, αἵτινες δύνανται νὰ συντηρῶσι τὸ σώμα ἢ νὰ διαλύωσι τοὺς δεσμούς του.
[Emergent] Ἡ βαρύτης τῆς νόσου ἐξαρτᾶται μᾶλλον ἀπὸ τὸ βάθος καὶ τὴν ἀλληλεξάρτησιν τοῦ προσβεβλημένου μηχανισμοῦ ἢ ἀπὸ τὸ ἐπιφανὲς μέγεθος τῆς βλάβης.
[Attractor] Ἡ ἀντίθεσις φυσικῆς τάξεως καὶ παρὰ φύσιν ἀναστροφῆς ὀργανώνει ὅλην τὴν παθολογικὴν γενεσιουργίαν.
[Persistent] Ἡ ὀνοματολογία ὀφείλει νὰ ἀκολουθῇ τὴν γένεσιν, τὴν ὁδόν, τὴν ποιότητα καὶ τὴν ἕξιν τῆς ὕλης.
[Terminal] Ἡ πήξις, ἡ κατάκλεισις καὶ ἡ στέρησις διεξόδων δύνανται νὰ μετατρέψωσι τὴν ἐσωτερικὴν διαφοράν εἰς συστημικὴν ἀναστροφήν.
[Attractor] Τὸ νοσοῦν σῶμα γίνεται φορεὺς τῆς ἰδίας αὐτοῦ διαφθορᾶς, ἐπειδὴ ἡ νοσηρὰ ὕλη ἀνακυκλοῦται καὶ πολλαπλασιάζει τὰς βλάβας.
Ἡ «φθορά» ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ἀρχικῶς ὡς μεταβολὴ χρώματος καὶ συστάσεως, ἔπειτα δὲ μεταλλάσσεται εἰς διάλυσιν δεσμῶν, σῆψιν καὶ συστημικὴν ἀναστροφήν.
Ἡ «ῥοή» μετακινείται ἀπὸ τὴν φυσικὴν κυκλοφορίαν τῶν χυμῶν εἰς τὴν ἄτακτον μετάδοσιν νοσηρᾶς ὕλης.
Ἡ «ἀναπνοή» μεταβάλλει λειτουργίαν: ἀπὸ μηχανισμὸν ψύξεως καὶ διανομῆς γίνεται ἀπόφραξις, ἔλλειψις, πλεονασμὸς καὶ σήψις.
Ἡ «τροφή» ἀποσπᾶται ἀπὸ τὴν τροφοδοτικὴν λειτουργίαν καὶ μετατίθεται εἰς διαβρωτικὸν παράγοντα διαλύσεως τῶν δεσμῶν.
Ἡ «χολή» ἀπὸ γένος παθολογικῶν σωμάτων γίνεται μηχανισμὸς θερμότητος, πήξεως, κατασβέσεως καὶ τρόμου.
Ἡ «τάξις» διατηρεῖται ὡς κοινὸς ἄξων, ἀλλὰ μετατοπίζεται ἀπὸ περιόδους αἵματος εἰς ἶνας, δεσμούς, διεξόδους καὶ πυκνότητας.
Ἡ διάκρισις μεταξὺ ἐπιφανείας καὶ βάθους ἀπορροφᾶται εἰς ἱεραρχίαν κλιμακουμένην ἀπὸ σάρκα διὰ ὀστοῦ καὶ μυελοῦ πρὸς θάνατον.
Ἡ ἀκριβὴς διάκρισις χολῆς, ἰχώρος καὶ φλέγματος μένει τοπικὴ ταξινομία, ἐπειδὴ ἡ cluster-κλίμακα διατηρεῖ κυρίως τὸν κοινὸν μηχανισμὸν μεταβολῆς.
Ἡ ἀκεραιότης σαρκὸς καὶ ὀστέων, ἡ ἀναπνοὴ καὶ ἡ θρέψις κλιμακοῦνται εἰς γενικὴν θεωρίαν ἀμοιβαίας ἐξαρτήσεως.
Ἡ ἐσωτερικὴ κίνησις φλέγματος καὶ χολῆς γεφυροῖ τὴν ταξινόμησιν τῶν χυμῶν μετὰ τῆς ἀνατομικῆς μεταδόσεως.
Ἡ φυσιολογικὴ ἰδέα τῆς ἀποφορτίσεως γίνεται current-level μηχανισμὸς διακρίσεως μεταξὺ ἀναστρέψιμου καὶ κλιμακουμένης νόσου.
Ἡ τοπικὴ ἀπόφραξις τοῦ πνεύμονος καταλύει τὴν ἀπομόνωσιν τῶν ὀργάνων καὶ γίνεται πρότυπον γενικῆς συστημικῆς κλιμακώσεως.
Ἡ ὀνοματολογία τῶν νοσημάτων παύει νὰ εἶναι ἁπλὴ περιγραφή καὶ γίνεται στρατηγικὸς χάρτης ὁδῶν, ἕξεων καὶ μετασχηματισμῶν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται τὸ σῶμα ὡς στατικὸν ἄθροισμα αὐτοτελῶν μερῶν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ νόσος ὡς ἀκίνητος τοπικὴ βλάβη, ἥτις δύναται νὰ παραμείνῃ ἀνεξάρτητος ἀπὸ τὰ λοιπὰ συστήματα.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ὕλη ὡς σταθερὰ οὐσία ἄνευ ἐπιρροῆς θερμότητος, τόπου, μίξεως καὶ κινήσεως.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἐξήγησις τῆς νόσου διὰ μόνου τοῦ ὀνόματος ἢ τοῦ τελικοῦ συμπτώματος.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ πλήρης διάκρισις ὕλης, πνεύματος, αἵματος, τροφῆς καὶ ἀναπνοῆς.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἰδέα ὅτι ἡ νόσος ἔχει γραμμικὴν καὶ ἀναστρέψιμον μόνον πορείαν.
Ἡ νόσος οὐ δύναται νὰ νοηθῇ ὡς ἐξωτερικὴ ἐπιβολή, ἐπειδὴ παράγεται ἐκ τῆς ἐσωτερικῆς μεταβολῆς τῶν συστατικῶν.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἀπομόνωσις τοῦ αἰτίου ἀπὸ τὴν ὁδὸν καὶ τὴν κατάστασιν τῆς ὕλης.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ὑγεία ὡς ἅπαξ κεκτημένη κατάστασις, ἐπειδὴ ἀπαιτεῖ συνεχή ρύθμισιν πυκνότητος, θερμότητος καὶ κινήσεως.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ πλήρης ἀναγωγὴ τῶν συμπτωμάτων εἰς μίαν μόνην ἀρχήν, ἐπειδὴ κοινὸς μηχανισμὸς ἐκδηλοῦται διὰ πολλῶν ὁδῶν.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἀπόλυτος ἐξίσωσις ἐπιφανειακῆς σαρκικῆς βλάβης καὶ μυελικῆς νόσου.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ ὕλη παραμένει ἀκίνητος, ἁπλῆ καὶ ἀνεπηρέαστος ὑπὸ τῶν σχέσεων.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται ἡ νόσος ὡς ἁπλὸν συμβεβηκός, διότι ἡ παθολογία ἀναπτύσσει ἰδίαν κυκλοφορίαν καὶ παραγωγὴν.
Ἡ ἀπουσία ἀκεραίου συνδέσμου, καθαρᾶς διεξόδου καὶ ὀρθῆς ἀνακυκλώσεως ἀποτελεῖ τὴν κρυφὴν ἀρνητικὴν ὑπόθεσιν τοῦ συστήματος.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ πλήρης ἰατρικὴ ἀσφάλεια, ἐπειδὴ ὁ αὐτὸς μηχανισμὸς δύναται ἄλλοτε νὰ θεραπεύῃ καὶ ἄλλοτε νὰ νοσοποιῇ.
Ἡ θεωρία τῆς χυμικῆς μεταβολῆς καὶ ἡ θεωρία τῆς ἀνατομικῆς μεταδόσεως συγκλίνουσιν εἰς ἕνα μοντέλον, ὅπου ἡ ποιότης τῆς ὕλης καθορίζει τὴν ὁδὸν τῆς κλιμακώσεως.
Ἡ ἀπόφραξις ἐνώνει τὰ τρία πεδία τῆς παθολογίας: διακόπτει τὴν ἀναπνοήν, μεταβάλλει τὴν ῥοὴν καὶ ἐγκλείει τὴν νοσηρὰν ὕλην.
Ἡ τροφή καὶ ἡ ἀναπνοὴ ἀποκαλύπτονται ὡς συμμετρικοὶ μετασχηματιστικοὶ δίαυλοι, ὧν ἡ διατάραξις μετατρέπει τὴν εἴσοδον εἰς διάλυσιν ἢ κατάκλεισιν.
Ἡ μετάδοσις τῆς νόσου δὲν εἶναι ἁπλὴ μεταφορά, ἀλλὰ ἐνεργὸς ἀναπαραγωγή, ἐπειδὴ ἡ διεφθαρμένη ὕλη πολλαπλασιάζει τὰς ἀρχικὰς βλάβας.
Ἡ φυσικὴ ἀποφόρτισις καὶ ἡ παθολογικὴ κατάκλεισις ἀποτελοῦσιν ἀντιθέτους τροπὰς τοῦ αὐτοῦ μηχανισμοῦ ῥοῆς.
Ἡ ἰατρικὴ ταξινόμησις ἀναγκάζεται νὰ διατηρῇ ἅμα κοινὸν γένος καὶ ἐσωτερικὴν ἑτερογένειαν, ἐπειδὴ ὁ αὐτὸς μηχανισμὸς ἐκδηλοῦται διὰ διαφόρων ὁδῶν.
Ἡ σωματικὴ ἀιτιότης γίνεται θεωρία μετασχηματισμῶν, ὅπου ἡ νόσος ὁρίζεται ὄχι ἀπὸ τὴν ὕλην μόνην, ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ τὸν τρόπον ὃν ἡ ὕλη ἐνεργεῖ.
Ἡ τοπικὴ καὶ ἡ συστημικὴ παθολογία δὲν εἶναι δύο γένη, ἀλλὰ δύο φάσεις μιᾶς ἀλυσίδος μεταμορφώσεων.
Ἡ ἀνατομία, ἡ χυμολογία καὶ ἡ φυσιολογία συμπλέκονται εἰς ἕνα κοινὸν διαγνωστικὸν πεδίον, ὅπου ῥοή, ὄγκος, τόπος καὶ βάθος συμπαράγουσι τὸ σύμπτωμα.
Ἡ παθολογία παράγει χρονικότητα ἀναδρομικὴν καὶ σπειροειδῆ: τὸ ἀποτέλεσμα ἐπιστρέφει ὡς αἴτιον καὶ ἐπιτείνει τὴν προηγουμένην βλάβην.
Ἡ ἐπιστημονικὴ ἀναγωγὴ τῶν πολλῶν νοσημάτων εἰς ὀλίγους μηχανισμοὺς δὲν ἐξαλείφει τὴν διαφοράν, ἀλλὰ τὴν ἐπανατοποθετεῖ ὡς διαφοράν ὁδοῦ, τόπου καὶ ἕξεως.

items.text: Ἀκεραιότης δεσμῶν → ὀρθὴ θρέψις → διατήρησις ἱστῶν· διάλυσις δεσμῶν → διεφθαρμένη ὕλη → ἐπανείσοδος εἰς τὸ αἷμα → πολλαπλασιασμὸς βλάβης.
Ἔξοδος χυμοῦ → ἀποφόρτισις· κατάκλεισις → θερμότης καὶ καῦσις· πήξις → ψῦξις καὶ τρόμος.
Ἀπόφραξις πνεύμονος → ἀσύμμετρος κατανομὴ πνεύματος → ἐγκλεισμὸς → νευρικὴ διάτασις → σπασμός.
Ὁ ὄγκος καὶ ἡ ποιότης ἀλληλοτροφοδοτοῦνται: ἡ παρὰ φύσιν ποσότης ἐπιτείνει τὴν ἀλλοίωσιν, ἡ δὲ ἀλλοίωσις μεταβάλλει τὴν κίνησιν τοῦ ὄγκου.
Ἡ ἐπιφάνεια λειτουργεῖ ὡς ἔνδειξις, τὸ βάθος ὡς μηχανισμός, καὶ ἡ συστημικὴ ἀναστροφὴ ὡς τελικὸς ἀτρακτοειδὴς ἕλκων τῆς ἐξηγήσεως.
Ὁ κεντρικὸς ἑλκτικὸς πόλος εἶναι ἡ φυσικὴ τάξις, ἣ ἐπαναπροσδιορίζεται διὰ τῆς ἀπουσίας, τῆς ἀποφράξεως καὶ τῆς ἀναστροφῆς.

items.text: Φυσικὴ τροφή καὶ ἀναπνοή → ἀκεραιότης δεσμῶν καὶ ἱστῶν → ρυθμισμένη κυκλοφορία.
Κακὴ δίαιτα ἢ ἀπόφραξις → μεταβολὴ θρεπτικῆς ὕλης ἢ πνεύματος → διάλυσις, κατάκλεισις καὶ στέρησις διεξόδων.
Ἀλλοίωσις ὕλης → ἀπώλεια φυσικῆς ῥοῆς → πήξις, σῆψις, καῦσις ἢ ἄτακτος διασπορά.
Τοπικὴ βλάβη → μετάδοσις διὰ ἱστῶν καὶ αἵματος → πολλαπλασιασμὸς νοσημάτων → συστημικὴ ἀναστροφή.
Ποιότης, τόπος, ῥοή, θερμότης καὶ πυκνότης → ἀναταξινόμησις τῶν νοσημάτων κατὰ μηχανισμόν, οὐ κατὰ τελικὸν ὄνομα.
Ἐσωτερικὴ ἀναστροφὴ τῆς τάξεως → ἐπιστροφὴ τῆς νοσηρᾶς ὕλης → βάθυνσις → πόνος, σπασμός, θάνατος.

items.text: Φυσικὴ ῥοὴ → ποιοτικὴ ἀλλοίωσις → ἀπώλεια μέτρου → ἀπόφραξις ἢ διασπορά.
Ἀπώλεια δεσμοῦ, θρέψεως ἢ ἀναπνοῆς → τοπικὴ βλάβη → ἐπανείσοδος νοσηρᾶς ὕλης εἰς τὸ αἷμα.
Ἐπανείσοδος → κυκλοφοριακὴ μετάδοσις → βάθυνσις εἰς ὀστοῦν καὶ μυελόν → μείζων κίνδυνος.
Πήξις, ψῦξις, σῆψις καὶ νευρικὴ διάτασις → πόνος καὶ σπασμός → ἀναστροφὴ τῆς συνολικῆς λειτουργίας.
Ἡ ἀναστροφὴ ἐπιστρέφει εἰς τὸ σύστημα ὡς νέα αἰτία, ὥστε ἡ νόσος νὰ παράγῃ τὴν ἑαυτῆς κλιμάκωσιν.
Ἡ νόσος ἀναχαρτογραφεῖται ἀπὸ ἐπιφανειακὸν συμβεβηκὸς εἰς δυναμικὴν μετάδοσιν διὰ τοῦ σώματος.
Ἡ διάγνωσις μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ συμπτώματος εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν, τὸν τόπον καὶ τὴν κατάστασιν τῆς ὕλης.
Ἡ ἀνατομικὴ ἀπόστασις ἀντικαθίσταται ὑπὸ λειτουργικῆς συνδεσιμότητος: σάρξ, ὀστοῦν, μυελός, πνεῦμα καὶ αἷμα ἀποτελοῦσιν ἕν πεδίον.
Ἡ χρωματικὴ καὶ συμπτωματικὴ ποικιλία ἀναγνωρίζεται ὡς ἐπιφάνεια ὀλίγων μηχανισμῶν ῥοῆς, μίξεως, καύσεως καὶ πήξεως.
Ἡ θεραπευτικὴ σκέψις ἀναγκάζεται νὰ ἀναζητῇ τὴν ἀπόφραξιν, τὴν ἕξιν καὶ τὸ βάθος, οὐχὶ μόνον τὸ ἐμφανὲς πάθος.
Ἡ «ἱερότης» τοῦ νοσήματος ἀνασυντάσσεται ἐντὸς φυσικῆς αἰτιολογίας, χωρὶς νὰ ἀναιρεῖται ἡ ἐξαιρετικὴ δύναμις τῆς διαδικασίας.
Ἐπιφανειακῶς ἐμφανίζονται χρώματα, πυρετοί, καταρροαί, φλεγμοναί, σῆψις, τρόμος καὶ σπασμός.
Δομικῶς, τὰ συμπτώματα παράγονται ἐκ δεσμῶν, ἱστῶν, ἀγγείων, νεύρων, ἰνῶν, διεξόδων καὶ ῥοῶν.
Μεταστρατηγικῶς, ἡ ἐξήγησις μεταφέρει τὴν ἀναζήτησιν ἀπὸ τὸ σύμπτωμα εἰς τὴν ἀλυσίδα τῆς μεταδόσεως καὶ τοῦ μετασχηματισμοῦ.
Ὀντολογικῶς καὶ χρονικῶς, τὸ σῶμα εἶναι κυκλοφοροῦσα τάξις, ἧς ἡ διατάραξις ἐπεκτείνεται, ἐπιστρέφει καὶ ἀναστρέφει τὴν φυσικὴν λειτουργίαν.
Μεθοδολογικῶς, ἡ ἴδια ἡ θεωρία ἐπιτελεῖ τὴν μετακίνησιν ἀπὸ τὰ ὀνόματα εἰς τὰς ὁδούς, τὰς σχέσεις καὶ τὰς ἀναστροφάς.

items.text: Ἡ ἀναγωγὴ τῶν πολλῶν νοσημάτων εἰς ὀλίγους μηχανισμοὺς ἀπειλεῖ νὰ ἐξαλείψῃ τὴν ἐσωτερικὴν ἑτερογένειαν, ἣν ὅμως ἡ ταξινόμησις ἀναγκαίως διατηρεῖ.
Ἡ ἐξήγησις ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ τὴν μετάβασιν ἀπὸ χρώματος ἢ συμπτώματος εἰς σύστασιν καὶ αἰτίαν, ἥτις δὲν εἶναι πάντοτε ἀποδεικτή.
Ἡ ἀντίθεσις ῥοῆς καὶ πήξεως δὲν εἶναι ἁπλὴ δυαδικότης, ἐπειδὴ ἡ πήξις δύναται νὰ εἶναι καὶ φυσικὴ ρύθμισις καὶ παθολογικὴ κατάκλεισις.
Ἡ θεωρία τῆς ἀναπνοῆς ἀπαιτεῖ ἄμα διανομήν, ψύξιν, ἀποφυγὴν σήψεως καὶ ἐξήγησιν πόνου, ὥστε μία λειτουργία νὰ φέρῃ πολλὰς ἀξίας.
Ἡ «τάξις» μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ φυσικὸν περιοδικὸν ρυθμὸν εἰς ἀνατομικὴν ἀκεραιότητα, ἔπειτα εἰς ἰνώδη ρύθμισιν καὶ τέλος εἰς μηχανισμὸν ἀποκλεισμοῦ.
Ἡ «ἀναπνοή» μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ εἴσοδον πνεύματος εἰς διανομήν, ψύξιν, ἀποτροπὴν σήψεως καὶ, ὅταν ἀποφραχθῇ, εἰς πηγήν συστημικῆς φθορᾶς.
Ἡ «νόσος» μετακινείται ἀπὸ ποιότητα σώματος εἰς ἀποτυχία μετασχηματισμοῦ καὶ ἔπειτα εἰς αὐτοτροφοδοτούμενον κύκλον διαφθορᾶς.

items.text: Τὸ σύστημα φαντάζεται τὸ σῶμα ὡς ἕνα κυκλοφοριακὸν δίκτυον, ἐν ᾧ ἡ ὕλη, τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ οἱ δεσμοὶ ἀναδιανέμονται συνεχῶς.
Ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐντὸς τούτου τοῦ δικτύου δὲν εἶναι κυρίαρχος ὑποκείμενος, ἀλλὰ τόπος διελεύσεως, ρυθμίσεως ἢ ἐγκλεισμοῦ ὕλης.
Ὁ χρόνος τοῦ σώματος εἶναι περιοδικὸς καὶ ἀναδραστικός: ἡ φυσικὴ περίοδος δύναται νὰ διακοπῇ, νὰ ἀναστραφῇ καὶ νὰ ἐπιστρέψῃ ὡς νόσος.
Ἡ δυνατὴ ἐπέμβασις συνίσταται ὄχι εἰς ἀντιμετώπισιν ἑνὸς συμπτώματος, ἀλλὰ εἰς ἀποκατάστασιν ῥοῆς, διεξόδου, μέτρου καὶ συνδέσμου.
Τὰ ἀξιώματα ἀρκοῦσιν εἰς ἀνασύστασιν τῆς βασικῆς κινήσεως ἀπὸ φυσικὴν ῥύθμισιν εἰς τοπικὴν διατάραξιν, μετάδοσιν, βάθυνσιν καὶ συστημικὴν ἀναστροφήν.
Ἡ ἀνασύστασις διατηρεῖ τὴν ἑνότητα τοῦ μηχανισμοῦ χωρὶς νὰ ἐξαλείφῃ τὴν διαφορὰν χυμῶν, ἱστῶν, ὁδῶν καὶ βάθους.
Ὑποκαθορισμένη μένει ἡ ἀκριβὴς ἱεράρχησις τῶν μίξεων καὶ ἡ ἐνιαία σχέσις φλέγματος, χολῆς, ἰνῶν καὶ μυελοῦ.
Ἡ ἀρχιτεκτονικὴ εἶναι συνεκτικὴ ἐπειδὴ συνδέει προέλευσιν, κίνησιν, ποσότητα, ποιότητα, βάθος καὶ παθολογικὴν ἐνέργειαν.
Ἡ ἐλάχιστη ἀνασύστασις διασώζει τὴν πραγματικὴν κίνησιν τοῦ συστήματος, ἀλλὰ ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ τὴν ἀναδρομὴν ἐπιστροφὴν τῆς νοσηρᾶς ὕλης καὶ ἀπὸ τὴν ἔντασιν μεταξὺ ῥοῆς καὶ πήξεως.
Ἀνθεκτικὸν στοιχεῖον εἰς ἀξιωματικὴν συμπίεσιν παραμένει ἡ ἀμφισημία τῶν μηχανισμῶν, οἵτινες δύνανται καὶ νὰ συντηρῶσι καὶ νὰ νοσοποιοῦσι.
The central problem is how the natural regulation of fluids, tissues, and outlets is transformed into pathological reversal.
The explanation shifts disease from the isolated symptom to the interactions of flow, mixture, nourishment, respiration, and bond.
Local damage becomes a chain of transmission, which extends through the tissues and blood to the whole body.
Natural order does not mean immobility, but regulated circulation that maintains a mean between tenuity, thickness, heat, and cooling.
Pathology is demonstrated as a failure of transformation, when flow becomes enclosure, heat coagulation, and nourishment dissolution.
The gravity of disease escalates from the surface toward deeper mechanisms, until bodily order is reversed.
The movement of the system is spiral: disturbance produces new disturbance, and the circulation of diseased matter reinforces the initial damage.
The outcome is not merely one final symptom, but the reversal of the body's overall order.
[Persistent] The body exists as a network of interdependent flows, tissues, bonds, and outlets.
[Persistent] Natural health requires integrity of connections, proper nourishment, respiration, circulation, and a mean of density.
[Mutating] Matter does not retain a fixed identity, but changes according to place, time, heat, mixture, and movement.
[Persistent] Natural order is regulated flow, not immobility or the mere presence of matter.
[Emergent] Disease arises when transformation fails, so that nourishment, respiration, flow, or heat turn against the body.
[Emergent] Local pathology escalates through transmission from tissue to tissue, from bone to flesh, and from flesh to blood.
[Mutating] Nourishment and respiration are twofold channels, which can sustain the body or dissolve its bonds.
[Emergent] The gravity of disease depends more on the depth and interdependence of the affected mechanism than on the superficial magnitude of the damage.
[Attractor] The opposition between natural order and reversal contrary to nature organizes the whole pathological genesis.
[Persistent] Nomenclature must follow the origin, course, quality, and condition of matter.
[Terminal] Coagulation, enclosure, and deprivation of outlets can transform internal difference into systemic reversal.
[Attractor] The diseased body becomes the bearer of its own corruption, because diseased matter recirculates and multiplies injuries.
“Corruption” initially recurs as a change of color and constitution, but then mutates into dissolution of bonds, putrefaction, and systemic reversal.
“Flow” shifts from the natural circulation of humors to the disorderly transmission of diseased matter.
“Respiration” changes function: from a mechanism of cooling and distribution, it becomes obstruction, deficiency, excess, and putrefaction.
“Nourishment” is detached from its nutritive function and transferred into a corrosive factor in the dissolution of bonds.
“Bile” changes from a genus of pathological bodies into a mechanism of heat, coagulation, extinction, and trembling.
“Order” is retained as a common axis, but shifts from periods of blood to fibers, bonds, outlets, and densities.
The distinction between surface and depth is absorbed into a hierarchy escalating from flesh through bone and marrow toward death.
The precise distinction of bile, ichor, and phlegm remains a local taxonomy, because the cluster-scale chiefly retains the common mechanism of change.
The integrity of flesh and bones, respiration, and nourishment are escalated into a general theory of mutual dependence.
The internal movement of phlegm and bile bridges the classification of humors with anatomical transmission.
The physiological idea of discharge becomes a current-level mechanism for distinguishing reversible from escalating disease.
Local obstruction of the lung dissolves the isolation of organs and becomes a model of general systemic escalation.
The nomenclature of diseases ceases to be mere description and becomes a strategic map of courses, conditions, and transformations.
The body as a static aggregate of self-sufficient parts is rejected.
Disease as an immobile local injury, capable of remaining independent of the other systems, is rejected.
Matter as a stable substance unaffected by heat, place, mixture, and movement is rejected.
The explanation of disease by name alone or by the final symptom is rejected.
The complete separation of matter, pneuma, blood, nourishment, and respiration is rejected.
The idea that disease has only a linear and reversible course is rejected.
Disease cannot be understood as an external imposition, because it is produced from the internal change of the constituents.
The isolation of cause from the course and condition of matter is excluded.
Health as a condition acquired once and for all is excluded, because it requires continuous regulation of density, heat, and movement.
The complete reduction of symptoms to one single principle is excluded, because a common mechanism manifests itself through many courses.
The absolute equation of superficial fleshly damage and disease of the marrow is excluded.
A world in which matter remains immobile, simple, and unaffected by relations becomes impossible.
Disease as a simple accident becomes impossible, because pathology develops its own circulation and production.
The absence of an intact bond, a clear outlet, and proper recirculation constitutes the system's hidden negative hypothesis.
Complete medical security is excluded, because the same mechanism can at one time heal and at another produce disease.
The theory of humoral change and the theory of anatomical transmission converge in one model, in which the quality of matter determines the course of escalation.
Obstruction unites the three fields of pathology: it interrupts respiration, changes flow, and encloses diseased matter.
Nourishment and respiration are revealed as symmetrical transformative channels, whose disturbance transforms intake into dissolution or enclosure.
The transmission of disease is not simple transfer, but active reproduction, because corrupted matter multiplies the initial injuries.
Natural discharge and pathological enclosure are opposite modes of the same mechanism of flow.
Medical classification is compelled to maintain both a common genus and internal heterogeneity, because the same mechanism manifests itself through different courses.
Bodily causality becomes a theory of transformations, in which disease is defined not by matter alone, but by the manner in which matter acts.
Local and systemic pathology are not two genera, but two phases of one chain of transformations.
Anatomy, humoral theory, and physiology are interwoven into one common diagnostic field, in which flow, mass, place, and depth jointly produce the symptom.
Pathology produces a recursive and spiral temporality: the effect returns as cause and intensifies the preceding damage.
The scientific reduction of many diseases to a few mechanisms does not eliminate difference, but repositions it as a difference of course, place, and condition.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Integrity of bonds → proper nourishment → preservation of tissues; dissolution of bonds → corrupted matter → re-entry into the blood → multiplication of injury.
Exit of humor → discharge; enclosure → heat and burning; coagulation → cooling and trembling.
Obstruction of the lung → asymmetrical distribution of pneuma → confinement → nervous distension → spasm.
Mass and quality mutually nourish one another: quantity contrary to nature intensifies alteration, while alteration changes the movement of the mass.
The surface functions as indication, depth as mechanism, and systemic reversal as the explanation's final spindle-shaped attractor.
The central attractive pole is natural order, which is redefined through absence, obstruction, and reversal.

sections.original_name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Natural nourishment and respiration → integrity of bonds and tissues → regulated circulation.
Bad diet or obstruction → alteration of nutritive matter or pneuma → dissolution, enclosure, and deprivation of outlets.
Alteration of matter → loss of natural flow → coagulation, putrefaction, burning, or disorderly dispersal.
Local damage → transmission through tissues and blood → multiplication of diseases → systemic reversal.
Quality, place, flow, heat, and density → reclassification of diseases according to mechanism, not according to final name.
Internal reversal of order → return of diseased matter → deepening → pain, spasm, death.

sections.original_name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Natural flow → qualitative alteration → loss of measure → obstruction or dispersal.
Loss of bond, nourishment, or respiration → local damage → re-entry of diseased matter into the blood.
Re-entry → circulatory transmission → deepening into bone and marrow → greater danger.
Coagulation, cooling, putrefaction, and nervous distension → pain and spasm → reversal of overall function.
The reversal returns to the system as a new cause, so that disease produces its own escalation.
Disease is remapped from a superficial accident into dynamic transmission through the body.
Diagnosis moves from the name of the symptom to the course, place, and condition of matter.
Anatomical distance is replaced by functional connectivity: flesh, bone, marrow, pneuma, and blood constitute one field.
Chromatic and symptomatic variety is recognized as the surface of a few mechanisms of flow, mixture, burning, and coagulation.
Therapeutic thought is compelled to seek obstruction, condition, and depth, not merely the manifest affection.
The “sacredness” of the disease is reconstituted within natural causality, without the exceptional power of the process being annulled.
On the surface appear colors, fevers, catarrhs, inflammations, putrefaction, trembling, and spasm.
Structurally, symptoms are produced from bonds, tissues, vessels, nerves, fibers, outlets, and flows.
Metastrategically, the explanation transfers inquiry from the symptom to the chain of transmission and transformation.
Ontologically and temporally, the body is a circulating order, whose disturbance extends, returns, and reverses natural function.
Methodologically, the theory itself performs the shift from names to courses, relations, and reversals.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: The reduction of many diseases to a few mechanisms threatens to eliminate the internal heterogeneity that classification nonetheless necessarily preserves.
The explanation depends on the transition from color or symptom to constitution and cause, which is not always demonstrable.
The opposition of flow and coagulation is not a simple duality, because coagulation can be both natural regulation and pathological enclosure.
The theory of respiration requires at once distribution, cooling, avoidance of putrefaction, and explanation of pain, so that one function bears many values.
“Order” mutates from a natural periodic rhythm into anatomical integrity, then into fibrous regulation, and finally into a mechanism of exclusion.
“Respiration” changes from the intake of pneuma into distribution, cooling, prevention of putrefaction, and, when obstructed, into a source of systemic corruption.
“Disease” moves from a quality of the body to failure of transformation and then to a self-nourishing cycle of corruption.

sections.original_name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: The system imagines the body as a circulatory network in which matter, pneuma, and bonds are continually redistributed.
Within this network, the human being is not a sovereign subject, but a place of the passage, regulation, or confinement of matter.
The time of the body is periodic and reactive: the natural period can be interrupted, reversed, and return as disease.
Possible intervention consists not in addressing one symptom, but in restoring flow, outlet, measure, and bond.
The axioms suffice to reconstruct the basic movement from natural regulation to local disturbance, transmission, deepening, and systemic reversal.
The reconstruction preserves the unity of the mechanism without eliminating the difference of humors, tissues, courses, and depth.
The precise hierarchy of mixtures and the unified relation of phlegm, bile, fibers, and marrow remain underdetermined.
The architecture is coherent because it connects origin, movement, quantity, quality, depth, and pathological activity.
The minimal reconstruction preserves the system's actual movement, but depends on the recursive return of diseased matter and on the tension between flow and coagulation.
An element resistant to axiomatic compression remains the ambiguity of mechanisms, which can both sustain and produce disease.
Τὸ σύστημα ζητεῖ νὰ ἐξηγήσῃ τὴν ἠθικὴν παρεκτροπὴν ὡς παραγόμενον ἀποτέλεσμα σωματικῶν, ψυχικῶν, παιδευτικῶν καὶ πολιτικῶν σχέσεων.
Ἡ διάκρισις σώματος καὶ ψυχῆς μετασχηματίζεται εἰς κλίμακα ἀλληλοδιαπερατῶν κινήσεων, οὐχὶ εἰς ἀπόλυτον δυϊσμόν.
Ἡ νόσος ἀναταξινομεῖται ἀπὸ ἠθικὴν ἐνοχὴν εἰς ἀταξίαν κράσεων, παθῶν, ἔξεων καὶ κινήσεων.
Ἡ αἰτιότης διαχέεται ἀπὸ τὸ ἄτομον εἰς τὰ πλέγματα γενέσεως, τροφῆς, πολιτείας καὶ παιδείας.
Ἡ ἀντιστροφὴ τοῦ λόγου ἀπὸ τὴν διάγνωσιν τῶν κακῶν εἰς τὴν ἀναζήτησιν τῆς σωτηρίας ἐγκαθιστᾷ θεραπευτικὴν καὶ παιδευτικὴν στρατηγικήν.
Ἡ συμμετρία γίνεται καθολικὸς κανὼν ὑγείας, ἀρετῆς, καλλονῆς καὶ κοινωνικῆς εὐθύνης.
Ἡ θεραπεία δὲν ἐπιδιώκει ἀκινησίαν ἢ μονομερῆ ἐπικράτησιν, ἀλλὰ ἀμοιβαίαν, μετρίαν καὶ συνεχή ρύθμισιν κινήσεων.
Ἡ τελικὴ κίνησις τοῦ συστήματος ἄγει ἀπὸ τὴν ἀσύμμετρον ἐπικράτησιν εἰς τὴν ὁλοκληρωτικὴν τάξιν τοῦ συναμφοτέρου κατὰ μίμησιν τοῦ παντός.
[Persistent] Τὸ ἀνθρώπινον ζῷον ὑφίσταται ὡς συναμφότερον ψυχῆς καὶ σώματος, ὧν οὐδετέρου ἡ αὐτάρκεια ἐπαρκεῖ.
[Persistent] Ἡ σωματικὴ ἕξις δύναται νὰ μεταδίδῃ τὴν διαταραχὴν εἰς τὴν ψυχήν, ὥσπερ καὶ ἡ ψυχικὴ ὑπεροχὴ δύναται νὰ βλάπτῃ τὸ σῶμα.
[Persistent] Ἡ νόσος ἐκπηγάζει ἐκ ἀσυμμέτρου ἢ ἀτάκτου κρατήσεως ἐναντίων κινήσεων.
[Mutating] Ἡ ὑπερβολὴ μετακινείται ἀπὸ τὴν ἁπλὴν ποσότητα στοιχείου εἰς τὴν ἀδυναμίαν ἑνὸς μέρους νὰ συνυπάρχῃ μετὰ τοῦ ὅλου.
[Emergent] Ἡ ἄνοια καὶ ἡ σωματικὴ νόσος εἶναι δύο ἐκφάνσεις ἑνὸς ἀσυμμέτρου συστήματος, οὐχὶ δύο ἀνεξάρτηται ἀσθένειαι.
[Mutating] Ἡ ἠθικὴ πράξις ἀναλύεται ὡς ἀποτέλεσμα προγενεστέρων κράσεων, ἀγωγῶν, τροφῶν καὶ κοινωνικῶν λόγων.
[Emergent] Ἡ ἰατρική, ἡ παιδεία καὶ ἡ πολιτικὴ τάξις συμπλέκονται εἰς ἕν θεραπευτικὸν πεδίον.
[Persistent] Τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀγαθὸν ὁρίζονται διὰ συμμετρίας, ἀναλογίας καὶ ἀποφυγῆς ἀσυμμέτρου ὑπεροχῆς.
[Mutating] Ἡ συμμετρία ἀναπτύσσεται ἀπὸ στατικὴν ἀναλογίαν εἰς ἀμοιβαίαν ἀνταπόδοσιν καὶ ρύθμισιν κινήσεων.
[Attractor] Ἡ τάξις τοῦ παντὸς παρέχει πρότυπον διὰ τὴν θεραπείαν καὶ τὴν ἀνασύνταξιν τῶν ἀνθρωπίνων μερῶν.
[Terminal] Ἡ θεραπεία ἀπαιτεῖ ταυτοχρόνως μεταβολὴν σώματος, ἔθους, μαθήσεως, κινήσεως καὶ κοινωνικῶν συνθηκῶν.
[Tension] Ἡ ἀπόρριψις τῆς καθαρᾶς ἑκουσιότητος δὲν ἀφανίζει τὴν παιδευτικὴν κατεύθυνσιν, ἀλλὰ μετατοπίζει τὴν εὐθύνην πρὸς τοὺς μηχανισμοὺς διαμορφώσεως.
Ἡ ἀλληλεξάρτησις σώματος καὶ ψυχῆς ἐπαναλαμβάνεται σταθερῶς, ἀλλὰ μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ μετάδοσιν νόσου εἰς ἀμοιβαίαν ρύθμισιν κινήσεων.
Ἡ ὑπερβολὴ ἀρχικῶς σημαίνει στοιχειακὴν ἢ χυμώδη διατάραξιν, ἔπειτα δὲ σημαίνει ἀσύμμετρον ἐπικράτησιν μέρους ἐντὸς τοῦ ὅλου.
Ἡ ἠθικὴ κατηγορία μετατοπίζεται ἀπὸ τὸ τελικὸν πρόσωπον πρὸς τοὺς φορεῖς γενέσεως, τροφῆς καὶ παιδείας.
Ἡ θεραπεία ἀποβάλλει τὸ πρότυπον τῆς ἁπλῆς νουθεσίας καὶ ἀποκτᾷ σύνθετον μορφὴν σωματικῆς, παιδευτικῆς καὶ πολιτικῆς μεταβολῆς.
Ἡ συμμετρία μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ κριτήριον κάλλους εἰς δυναμικὸν μηχανισμὸν ἀνταποδόσεως, ὅστις παράγει ὑγείαν.
Ἡ ἀκινησία, ἡ ὁποία δὲν εἶχεν ἀρχικῶς κεντρικὴν θέσιν, ἐπανεμφανίζεται ὡς ἀρνητικὸς πόλος τῆς θεραπευτικῆς κινήσεως.
Ἡ λεπτομερὴς θεωρία χυμῶν, ἀτμῶν καὶ στοιχείων παραμένει τοπικὴ μηχανικὴ ἐξηγήσεως, ἐνώ ἐπὶ τοῦ παρόντος ἐπιπέδου διασώζεται ὡς γενικὸς τύπος σωματικῆς διαταράξεως.
Ἡ τριμερὴς ψυχὴ καὶ ἡ ἀκριβὴς ἀντιστοίχισις νοσημάτων πρὸς τὰ μέρη αὐτῆς εἶναι χαμηλοτέρου ἐπιπέδου ὑπόθεσις, ἡ δὲ γενικὴ ἀρχὴ τῆς μεσολαβήσεως παραμένει κεντρική.
Ἡ σύζευξις γυμναστικῆς, μουσικῆς καὶ φιλοσοφίας εἶναι συγκεκριμένον παιδευτικὸν παράδειγμα, τὸ ὁποῖον ἀναβαθμίζεται εἰς κανόνα ἀμοιβαίας καλλιεργείας.
Ἡ κοσμολογικὴ μίμησις δὲν εἶναι πλέον τοπικὴ εἰκών, ἀλλὰ γίνεται ὑπερκείμενον πρότυπον ὅλης τῆς θεραπευτικῆς ἀρχιτεκτονικῆς.
Ἡ ἀτομικὴ ἀσθένεια καὶ ἡ ἀτομικὴ κακία δὲν ἀρκούν πλέον ὡς αὐτοτελεῖς κατηγορίαι· ὑπάγονται εἰς ἐνιαῖον δίκτυον διαμορφώσεως.
Ἡ ἀκριβὴς μέτρησις τῆς μετρίας κινήσεως καὶ ἡ πρακτικὴ μορφὴ τῆς θεραπευτικῆς παιδείας παραμένουν ὑποκαθορισμέναι καὶ δὲν ἀναβαθμίζονται εἰς καθολικὰς ἀρχάς.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ψυχὴ ὡς ἀνεξάρτητος κυβερνήτης τῶν παθῶν καὶ τῶν πράξεων.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ κακία ὡς καθαρῶς ἑκούσιος καὶ ἐσωτερικῶς αὐτογενὴς ἀπόφασις.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ θεραπεία ὡς λόγος ἄνευ τροφῆς, ἔθους, κινήσεως καὶ μαθήσεως.
Ἀπορρίπτεται τὸ καλὸν ὡς μέγεθος, δύναμις ἢ ἀπλῆ ὑπεροχή· ἡ ἀξία ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ τὴν σχέσιν πρὸς τὸ ὅλον.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἀκινησία ὡς οὐδετέρα ἢ θεραπευτική· ἡ σωτηρία ἀπαιτεῖ τεταγμένην κίνησιν.
Οὐ δύναται νὰ σταθῇ τὸ σύστημα ἐπὶ κόσμου ὅπου ψυχή, σῶμα, παιδεία καὶ πολιτεία ἔχουσιν ἀνεξάρτητα αἴτια.
Οὐ δύναται νὰ ἀναγνωρισθῇ ἡ νόσος ὡς ἁπλὴ ἐξωτερικὴ προσβολή, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἀταξία παράγεται ἐντὸς τῶν ἀλληλοκρατουμένων κινήσεων.
Οὐκ ἐπαρκεῖ ἡ γνώσις μόνη πρὸς τὴν θεραπείαν, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἔξις τοῦ σώματος καὶ τὸ περιβάλλον συμπαράγουσι τὴν πράξιν.
Οὐκ ἐπιτρέπεται ἡ ἀξιολόγησις ἑνὸς μέρους ἄνευ τοῦ ὅλου, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ὑπεροχὴ δύναται νὰ μεταβληθῇ εἰς βλάβην.
Ἡ βαθύτερα ἀποκλειομένη δυνατότης εἶναι ἡ ὕπαρξις ἀμέτοχου, ἀσυσχετίστου καὶ ἑαυτοκυβερνωμένης ψυχῆς.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ ἠθικὴ ἐνοχὴ ἀποκόπτεται ἀπὸ τὰς φυσικὰς καὶ κοινωνικὰς συνθήκας γενέσεως.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται ἡ σωτηρία ὡς ἀκινησία, ἀπόσπασις ἢ μονομερὴς ἐπικράτησις τοῦ πνευματικοῦ.
Ἡ ἀπουσία, περὶ ἧς περιστρέφεται τὸ σύστημα, εἶναι ἡ ἀπουσία ἀσυμμέτρου μέρους ὃ δύναται νὰ σωθῇ μόνο του.
Ἡ ἠθικὴ συμπεριφορὰ μετατρέπεται εἰς φαινόμενον ἐνσώματον καὶ κοινωνικῶς παραγόμενον, ὅταν ἡ φυσιολογικὴ διαταραχὴ συνδεθῇ μετὰ τῆς ἀγωγῆς.
Ἡ μετάθεσις τῆς κακίας ἀπὸ τὸ ἄτομον εἰς τὸ πλέγμα γενέσεως καὶ τροφῆς ἀπαιτεῖ ὄχι ἀκύρωσιν τῆς παιδείας, ἀλλὰ ἀνασύνταξιν τῶν ὑπευθύνων μηχανισμῶν.
Ἡ συμμετρία γίνεται δυναμικὴ ἀρχή, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἀναλογία τοῦ ὅλου μετασχηματίζεται εἰς ἀμοιβαίαν κίνησιν καὶ ρύθμισιν.
Ἡ ἀπόρριψις τῆς ψυχῆς ὡς αὐτάρκους ἀρχῆς καὶ ἡ ἀπόρριψις τῆς ἀκινησίας συγκροτοῦσιν ἀρνητικὸν ὅρον ὅλης τῆς θεραπευτικῆς λογικῆς.
Ἡ ἱεράρχησις τῆς ψυχῆς ὡς κρείττονος συνυπάρχει ἀσταθῶς μετὰ τῆς ἀναγκαίας σωματικῆς ἀνταποδόσεως, ὥστε ἡ ὑπεροχὴ νὰ μὴν ἰσοδυναμῇ μὲ αὐτάρκειαν.
Ἡ θεραπεία ἀνασυντάσσει ταὐτοχρόνως τὸ ἄτομον καὶ τὰ περιβάλλοντα αἴτια, διότι ἡ παιδεία ἡ ἴδια ὀφείλει νὰ κινηθῇ σωματικῶς, μουσικῶς, φιλοσοφικῶς καὶ πολιτικῶς.
Τὸ ὑποκείμενον παύει νὰ νοεῖται ὡς ἀρχὴ τῶν πράξεων καὶ γίνεται κόμβος ἐντὸς ἀλληλεπιδρώντων σωματικῶν, παιδευτικῶν καὶ πολιτικῶν ῥοῶν.
Ὁ χρόνος τῆς πράξεως γίνεται γενεαλογικός· ἡ παροῦσα κακία φέρει ἐν ἑαυτῇ προγενεστέρους τρόπους τροφῆς, ἀγωγῆς καὶ κράσεως.
Ἡ ἀνθρώπινη ὑγεία ἀναδεικνύεται ὡς ἐνεργὸς παραγωγὴ τάξεως, οὐχὶ ὡς παθητικὴ ἀπουσία συμπτωμάτων.
Ἡ θεραπευτικὴ γνώσις μετασχηματίζεται εἰς ἐπιστήμην σχέσεων, ἥτις ὀφείλει νὰ ρυθμίζῃ ὅλον τὸ δίκτυον καὶ οὐχὶ ἕν μόνον μέρος.
Ἡ πολιτικὴ εὐθύνη ἐπανακαθορίζεται ὡς εὐθύνη παραγωγῆς σωμάτων, ἔξεων, λόγων καὶ μαθημάτων, ὄχι μόνον ὡς ἐπιβολὴ κυρώσεων.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Στοιχειακὴ ἢ σωματικὴ ὑπερβολή → διατάραξις σώματος → ψυχικὴ ἄνοια → φαινομένη κακία → ἀναγωγὴ εἰς σωματικὰ καὶ παιδευτικὰ αἴτια.
Ἡ ἀναγωγὴ τῆς κακίας εἰς τὰ αἴτια μετατρέπεται εἰς ἀντιστροφὴν: ἡ ἐξήγησις τῶν κακῶν γεννᾷ τὴν ἀναζήτησιν τῶν αἰτίων τῆς σωτηρίας.
Ἡ ἀσυμμετρία ἑνὸς μέρους → ἀσθένεια τοῦ ἑτέρου → ἐπέκτασις τῆς ἀγωγῆς → ἀμοιβαία ἀνταπόδοσις → ἀνασύνταξις τοῦ ὅλου.
Ἡ συμμετρία ἀρχικῶς ὀρίζει τὸ κάλλος, ἔπειτα ὀρίζει τὴν ὑγείαν, καὶ τέλος γίνεται μηχανὴ ρυθμίσεως τῶν κινήσεων.
Ἡ κίνησις γίνεται ἔννοια-μηχανή: ἡ ἄτακτος κίνησις παράγει νόσον, ἡ δὲ μετρία καὶ συνεχὴς κίνησις παράγει τάξιν.
Ὁ κεντρικὸς ἐλκυστὴς εἶναι τὸ συναμφότερον, ἐν ᾧ ἡ φύσις τοῦ παντὸς ἐπιστρέφει ὡς πρότυπον διὰ τὴν ἀνθρωπίνην θεραπείαν.

items.text: Σωματικὴ κράσις καὶ στοιχειακὴ ὑπερβολὴ → ἐσωτερικὴ διατάραξις τοῦ σώματος.
Σωματικὴ ἕξις → μετάδοσις εἰς τὴν ψυχήν → ἄνοια, μανία ἢ ἀμαθία.
Ἄνοια καὶ πάθος → ἀπώλεια ὀρθῆς κρίσεως → πράξις φαινομένη ἑκούσιος.
Σωματικὴ προδιάθεσις + κακὴ πολιτεία + ἀπαίδευτος ἀγωγή → ἀκουσία γένεσις κακίας καὶ μετατόπισις τῆς εὐθύνης.
Ἀναγνώρισις τῆς ἀλληλεξαρτήσεως → ἀπόρριψις τῆς μονομερείας → ἀνταπόδοσις ψυχικῶν καὶ σωματικῶν κινήσεων.
Συνεχὴς μετρία κίνησις → σύνταξις συγγενῶν μερῶν → ὑγεία, ἀρετή, κάλλος καὶ ὁ καλὸς ἄνθρωπος.

sections.original_name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Ἀρχικὴ φυσιολογικὴ ὑπερβολή → σωματικὴ νόσος → ψυχικὴ διαφθορά → ἠθικὴ παρεκτροπή.
Ἀναθεώρησις τῆς ἑκουσιότητος → διάχυσις τῆς αἰτιότητος εἰς τροφήν, πολιτείαν καὶ παιδείαν → θεραπευτικὴ ἀντιστροφή.
Συμμετρία ὡς κανών → ἀμοιβαία κίνησις ψυχῆς καὶ σώματος → μίμησις τῆς κοσμικῆς τάξεως → ὑγεία τοῦ συναμφοτέρου.
Ἡ ἠθικὴ κατηγορία ἀντικαθίσταται ὑπὸ γενεαλογικὴν καὶ θεραπευτικὴν χαρτογράφησιν τῶν ὅρων τῆς πράξεως.
Ἡ διάκρισις σώματος καὶ ψυχῆς ὑποχωρεῖ μπροστὰ εἰς ἀναλυτικὴν τῆς μεταξύ των συμμετρίας καὶ ἀλληλοκρατήσεως.
Ἡ θεραπεία ἐπεκτείνεται ἀπὸ τὸ ἐσωτερικὸν φρόνημα εἰς τὸ σῶμα, τὴν τροφήν, τὸ ἔθος, τὴν παιδείαν καὶ τὴν πολιτείαν.
Ἡ ὑγεία ἀναταξινομεῖται ὡς ἐνεργὸς τάξις σχέσεων, ὥστε ἡ ἀπουσία συμπτώματος νὰ μὴν ἀποτελῇ πλέον ἐπαρκῆ ὁρισμόν.
Ἡ κοσμολογία καθίσταται πρακτικὸς ὁδηγός: ἡ θεραπεία τῶν ἀνθρωπίνων μερῶν ἀπαιτεῖ θεωρίαν τοῦ ὅλου.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ἐπιφανειακοῦ ἐπιπέδου, πυρετοί, χυμοί, πάθη, ἀμαθία καὶ κακίαι φαίνονται ὡς συμπτώματα ἀσυμμέτρου κράσεως.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ δομικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ἡ ἀλληλεπίδρασις σώματος, ψυχῆς, πολιτείας καὶ παιδείας παράγει ἢ ἀποτρέπει τὴν κακίαν.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεταστρατηγικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ἡ ἐπέμβασις μεταφέρεται ἀπὸ τὴν μομφὴν τοῦ προσώπου εἰς τὴν ἀναμόρφωσιν τῶν συνθηκῶν γενέσεως.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὀντολογικοῦ καὶ χρονικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὸ ζῷον γίνεται γίγνεσθαι σχέσεων, ὄχι ἕτοιμον αὐτοτελὲς ὑποκείμενον.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ performative ἐπιπέδου, ἡ ἴδια ἡ δομὴ τοῦ λόγου μιμεῖται τὸ ἀντικείμενόν της, ἐπειδὴ συνδέει διαδοχικῶς διασπασμένα μέρη εἰς ἕν ὅλον.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ ἀπόρριψις τῆς καθαρᾶς ἑκουσιότητος ἀποδυναμοῖ τὴν προσωπικὴν ἐνοχήν, ἀλλὰ ἀναγκάζει τὸ σύστημα νὰ διατηρήσῃ κάποιαν μορφὴν κατευθυντικῆς εὐθύνης.
Ἡ ἀνάγκη συνεχούς κινήσεως συγκρούεται μὲ τὴν ἀνάγκην μετρίας κινήσεως, ἐπειδὴ ἡ σωτηρία δὲν ὁρίζεται ἀκριβῶς ὡς ποσὸν ἢ ῥυθμός.
Ἡ ὑπεροχὴ τῆς ψυχῆς διατηρεῖ ἱεραρχικὴν χροιάν, ἐνώ ἡ θεραπεία ἀπαιτεῖ ἀμοιβαίαν ἐξάρτησιν καὶ ἀνταπόδοσιν.
Ἡ μετατόπισις τῆς εὐθύνης πρὸς τοὺς γεννῶντας καὶ τρέφοντας δύναται νὰ ἀναπαράγῃ ἐνοχοποίησιν ἑτέρου ἐπιπέδου, ἣν τὸ σύστημα δὲν ἐπιλύει πλήρως.
Ἡ ἠθικὴ κακία μεταλλάσσεται εἰς νόσον, ἡ δὲ νόσος μεταλλάσσεται εἰς διαταραχὴν κινήσεων· ἐνταῦθα ἡ ἠθικὴ κατηγορία ἀποκτᾷ φυσιολογικὸν καὶ κοσμολογικὸν βάθος.
Ἡ συμμετρία μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ μορφολογικὸν κριτήριον εἰς θεραπευτικὸν τελεστήν, ὅστις ρυθμίζει τὰς σχέσεις τῶν μερῶν.
Ἡ ἀκινησία μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ φαινομενικὴν ἡσυχίαν εἰς ἐνεργὸν μηχανισμὸν φθορᾶς, ἐνώ ἡ κίνησις ἀναλαμβάνει θεραπευτικὴν λειτουργίαν.

sections.original_name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ πραγματικότης νοεῖται ὡς ζῶν σύστημα ἀλληλοκρατουμένων κινήσεων, ἐν ᾧ οὐδὲν μέρος ἐνεργεῖ ἀμέτοχον τοῦ ὅλου.
Τὸ ὑποκείμενον εἶναι συναμφότερον κόμβος, ὃς ὑφίσταται διὰ τῆς ἀνταποδόσεως ψυχικῶν, σωματικῶν καὶ παιδευτικῶν κινήσεων.
Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι γενεαλογικὸς καὶ ρυθμικός: συσσωρεύει κράσεις καὶ ἀγωγὰς, ἀλλὰ δύναται νὰ ἀνασυνταχθῇ διὰ συνεχοῦς ρυθμίσεως.
Ἡ δυνατὴ ἔξοδος δὲν εἶναι ἀπόδρασις ἑνὸς μέρους, ἀλλὰ μεταβολὴ τῆς ἐχθρᾶς κρατήσεως εἰς φιλικὴν σύνταξιν καὶ κοσμικὴν ἀναλογίαν.
Οἱ παρόντες καθολικοὶ ἄξονες ἀρκοῦσι πρὸς ἀνακατασκευὴν τῆς βασικῆς κινήσεως ἀπὸ τὴν φυσιολογικὴν διατάραξιν εἰς τὴν κοινωνικοπαιδευτικὴν καὶ θεραπευτικὴν ἀνασύνταξιν.
Ἡ ἀνακατασκευὴ διατηρεῖ τὴν ἀναγκαίαν διαδοχήν: σῶμα → ψυχή → κακία → αἰτιότης → συμμετρία → ἀμοιβαία κίνησις → ὑγεία.
Ὑποκαθορισμένα μένουσι τὸ ἀκριβὲς μέτρον τῆς μετρίας κινήσεως, ἡ πρακτικὴ μορφὴ τῆς παιδείας καὶ τὸ κανονιστικὸν καθεστὼς τῆς εὐθύνης.
Ἡ συνοχὴ τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι ἰσχυροτάτη ἐν τῇ συνδέσει σώματος, ψυχῆς, πάθους, παιδείας καὶ κινήσεως, ἀλλὰ ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ τὴν ἀναλογικὴν καὶ ῥητορικὴν ἀντιστροφὴν τοῦ λόγου.
Ἡ ἀξιωματικὴ συμπίεσις διασώζει τὸν γενεσιουργὸν μηχανισμόν, ἀλλὰ δὲν ἀφανίζει τὴν ἄλυτον ἔντασιν μεταξὺ φυσιολογικῆς ἀναγκαιότητος, παιδευτικῆς ἐπεμβάσεως καὶ προσωπικῆς εὐθύνης.
The system seeks to explain moral deviation as a derivative result of bodily, psychic, educational, and political relations.
The distinction between body and soul is transformed into a scale of interpenetrating motions, not into absolute dualism.
Disease is reclassified from moral culpability into a disorder of mixtures, affections, dispositions, and motions.
Causality is diffused from the individual into the networks of generation, nourishment, polity, and education.
The reversal of the argument from the diagnosis of evils to the search for salvation establishes a therapeutic and educational strategy.
Symmetry becomes a universal rule of health, virtue, beauty, and social responsibility.
Therapy does not seek immobility or one-sided predominance, but reciprocal, moderate, and continuous regulation of motions.
The system's final movement leads from asymmetrical predominance to the integral order of the soul-body composite in imitation of the whole.
[Persistent] The human living creature exists as a soul-body composite, neither of whose self-sufficiency suffices.
[Persistent] A bodily disposition can transmit disorder to the soul, just as psychic predominance can harm the body.
[Persistent] Disease springs from the asymmetrical or disorderly predominance of contrary motions.
[Mutating] Excess shifts from the mere quantity of an element to the inability of one part to coexist with the whole.
[Emergent] Folly and bodily disease are two manifestations of one asymmetrical system, not two independent illnesses.
[Mutating] Moral action is analyzed as the result of antecedent mixtures, upbringings, nourishments, and social accounts.
[Emergent] Medicine, education, and political order are interwoven into one therapeutic field.
[Persistent] The beautiful and the good are defined through symmetry, proportion, and the avoidance of asymmetrical predominance.
[Mutating] Symmetry develops from static proportion into reciprocal requital and regulation of motions.
[Attractor] The order of the whole supplies a model for the therapy and reconstitution of human parts.
[Terminal] Therapy requires simultaneously the alteration of body, habit, learning, motion, and social conditions.
[Tension] The rejection of pure voluntariness does not eliminate educational direction, but shifts responsibility toward the mechanisms of formation.
The interdependence of body and soul recurs consistently, but mutates from the transmission of disease into reciprocal regulation of motions.
Excess initially signifies elemental or humoral disturbance, but subsequently signifies the asymmetrical predominance of a part within the whole.
Moral accusation shifts from the final person to the agents of generation, nourishment, and education.
Therapy sheds the model of mere admonition and acquires the complex form of bodily, educational, and political change.
Symmetry passes from a criterion of beauty into a dynamic mechanism of requital that produces health.
Immobility, which initially had no central position, reappears as the negative pole of therapeutic motion.
The detailed theory of humors, vapors, and elements remains a local mechanical explanation, whereas at the present level it is retained as a general type of bodily disturbance.
The tripartite soul and the precise correspondence of diseases to its parts are a lower-level hypothesis, while the general principle of mediation remains central.
The conjunction of gymnastics, music, and philosophy is a specific educational example, which is elevated into a rule of reciprocal cultivation.
Cosmological imitation is no longer a local image, but becomes the overarching model of the entire therapeutic architecture.
Individual illness and individual vice no longer suffice as self-standing categories; they are subsumed under a unified network of formation.
The precise measure of moderate motion and the practical form of therapeutic education remain underdetermined and are not elevated into universal principles.
The soul as an independent governor of affections and actions is rejected.
Vice as a purely voluntary and internally self-generated decision is rejected.
Therapy as discourse without nourishment, habit, motion, and learning is rejected.
The beautiful is rejected as magnitude, power, or simple superiority; value depends on relation to the whole.
Immobility as neutral or therapeutic is rejected; salvation requires ordered motion.
The system cannot stand upon a world in which soul, body, education, and polity have independent causes.
Disease cannot be recognized as a mere external assault, because disorder is produced within mutually prevailing motions.
Knowledge alone does not suffice for therapy, because bodily disposition and environment jointly produce action.
The evaluation of one part without the whole is not permitted, because predominance can turn into harm.
The more deeply excluded possibility is the existence of a non-participating, unrelated, and self-governing soul.
Impossible becomes a world in which moral culpability is severed from the natural and social conditions of its generation.
Impossible becomes salvation as immobility, separation, or the one-sided predominance of the spiritual.
The absence around which the system revolves is the absence of an asymmetrical part that can save itself alone.
Moral behavior is transformed into an embodied and socially produced phenomenon when physiological disorder is joined to upbringing.
The transfer of vice from the individual to the network of generation and nourishment requires not the annulment of education, but the reconstitution of the responsible mechanisms.
Symmetry becomes a dynamic principle, because the proportion of the whole is transformed into reciprocal motion and regulation.
The rejection of the soul as a self-sufficient principle and the rejection of immobility constitute a negative condition of the entire therapeutic logic.
The hierarchy of the soul as superior coexists unstably with necessary bodily requital, so that superiority does not amount to self-sufficiency.
Therapy reconstitutes simultaneously the individual and surrounding causes, because education itself must move bodily, musically, philosophically, and politically.
The subject ceases to be conceived as the principle of actions and becomes a node within interacting bodily, educational, and political flows.
The time of action becomes genealogical; present vice bears within itself prior modes of nourishment, upbringing, and mixture.
Human health emerges as an active production of order, not as a passive absence of symptoms.
Therapeutic knowledge is transformed into a science of relations, which must regulate the entire network and not only one part.
Political responsibility is redefined as responsibility for producing bodies, dispositions, discourses, and lessons, not merely as the imposition of sanctions.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Elemental or bodily excess → bodily disturbance → psychic folly → apparent vice → reduction to bodily and educational causes.
The reduction of vice to causes becomes a reversal: the explanation of evils generates the search for the causes of salvation.
The asymmetry of one part → illness of the other → extension of upbringing → reciprocal requital → reconstitution of the whole.
Symmetry initially defines beauty, then defines health, and finally becomes a mechanism for regulating motions.
Motion becomes a concept-machine: disorderly motion produces disease, whereas moderate and continuous motion produces order.
The central attractor is the soul-body composite, in which the nature of the whole returns as a model for human therapy.

sections.original_name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Bodily mixture and elemental excess → internal disturbance of the body.
Bodily disposition → transmission to the soul → folly, madness, or ignorance.
Folly and affection → loss of correct judgment → apparently voluntary action.
Bodily predisposition + bad polity + uneducated upbringing → involuntary generation of vice and displacement of responsibility.
Recognition of interdependence → rejection of one-sidedness → requital of psychic and bodily motions.
Continuous moderate motion → ordering of kindred parts → health, virtue, beauty, and the good human being.

sections.original_name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Initial physiological excess → bodily disease → psychic corruption → moral deviation.
Revision of voluntariness → diffusion of causality into nourishment, polity, and education → therapeutic reversal.
Symmetry as rule → reciprocal motion of soul and body → imitation of cosmic order → health of the soul-body composite.
Moral accusation is replaced by a genealogical and therapeutic mapping of the conditions of action.
The distinction between body and soul yields before an analysis of their mutual symmetry and mutual predominance.
Therapy extends from inner disposition to body, nourishment, habit, education, and polity.
Health is reclassified as an active order of relations, so that the absence of a symptom no longer constitutes a sufficient definition.
Cosmology becomes a practical guide: therapy of human parts requires a theory of the whole.
At the surface level, fevers, humors, affections, ignorance, and vices appear as symptoms of an asymmetrical mixture.
At the structural level, the interaction of body, soul, polity, and education produces or prevents vice.
At the metastrategic level, intervention is transferred from blaming the person to reforming the conditions of generation.
At the ontological and temporal level, the living creature becomes a becoming of relations, not a ready-made self-standing subject.
At the performative level, the very structure of the discourse imitates its object, because it successively joins fragmented parts into one whole.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: The rejection of pure voluntariness weakens personal culpability, but compels the system to retain some form of directive responsibility.
The need for continuous motion conflicts with the need for moderate motion, because salvation is not defined precisely as a quantity or rhythm.
The superiority of the soul retains a hierarchical coloration, whereas therapy requires reciprocal dependence and requital.
The displacement of responsibility toward those who generate and nourish can reproduce culpabilization at another level, which the system does not fully resolve.
Moral vice mutates into disease, and disease mutates into disturbance of motions; here the moral category acquires physiological and cosmological depth.
Symmetry mutates from a morphological criterion into a therapeutic operator that regulates the relations of the parts.
Immobility mutates from apparent quiet into an active mechanism of decay, while motion assumes a therapeutic function.

sections.original_name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Reality is conceived as a living system of mutually prevailing motions, in which no part acts without participating in the whole.
The subject is at once a node, existing through the requital of psychic, bodily, and educational motions.
Time is genealogical and rhythmic: it accumulates mixtures and upbringings, yet can be reconstituted through continuous regulation.
The possible exit is not the escape of one part, but the transformation of hostile predominance into friendly ordering and cosmic proportion.
The present universal axes suffice for reconstructing the basic movement from physiological disturbance to sociopedagogical and therapeutic reconstitution.
The reconstruction retains the necessary sequence: body → soul → vice → causality → symmetry → reciprocal motion → health.
The precise measure of moderate motion, the practical form of education, and the normative status of responsibility remain underdetermined.
The system's coherence is strongest in the connection of body, soul, affection, education, and motion, but depends upon the analogical and rhetorical reversal of the argument.
The axiomatic compression preserves the generative mechanism, but does not eliminate the unresolved tension between physiological necessity, educational intervention, and personal responsibility.
Τὸ πρόβλημα τοῦ συστήματος ἐστὶν ἡ εὕρεσις κινήσεως καὶ παιδείας αἳ θεραπεύουσι τὸ ζῷον ἄνευ παραβιάσεως τῆς φυσικῆς τάξεως.
Ἡ θεραπεία ἀναπλαισιοῦται ὡς ἱεράρχησις κινήσεων, ἀπὸ τῆς αὐτοκινήτου ἐνεργείας μέχρι τῆς ἐξωτερικῆς καὶ βιαίας ἐπεμβάσεως.
Ἡ σωματικὴ καὶ ἡ ψυχικὴ ἀγωγὴ ὑπάγονται εἰς ἓν σχήμα, ἐν ᾧ ἡ ἄριστη θεραπεία ἐνεργοποιεῖ τὸ θεραπευόμενον ἐκ τῶν ἔνδον.
Ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκλαμβάνεται ὡς διαφοροποιημένον σύστημα κινήσεων, οὗ ἡ θεραπεία συνίσταται οὐχὶ εἰς ὁμοιομορφίαν ἀλλ᾽ εἰς συμμετρίαν.
Ἡ φυσικὴ σύστασις τοῦ σώματος καὶ ἡ κοσμικὴ συγγένεια τῆς ψυχῆς παρέχουσι δύο κλίμακας τοῦ αὐτοῦ κανόνος: συνεργεῖν τῷ ὑφισταμένῳ ῥυθμῷ.
Ἡ γνώσις παύει νὰ εἶναι ἐξωτερικὴ κατοχή, καὶ γίνεται ἐπανόρθωσις τῶν κινήσεων τοῦ γνωρίζοντος.
Ἡ κίνησις τοῦ λόγου εἶναι σπειροειδής: ἀπὸ τὸ σῶμα μεταβαίνει εἰς τὴν ψυχήν, ἀπὸ τὴν ψυχήν εἰς τὸν κόσμον, καὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐπιστρέφει εἰς τὴν ἀγωγήν.
Ἡ κατάληξις οὐκ ἐστὶν ἀπόλυτος κυριαρχία ἐπὶ τῆς φύσεως, ἀλλὰ ἐξομοίωσις τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πρὸς τάξιν ἣν ἡ θεραπεία ὀφείλει νὰ μιμηθῇ.
[Persistent] Ἡ ἀξία πάσης θεραπευτικῆς κινήσεως κρίνεται κατὰ τὸν βαθμὸν τῆς ἐσωτερικῆς αὐτονομίας αὐτῆς.
[Persistent] Ἡ θεραπεία ἱεραρχεῖται ἀπὸ τῆς γυμναστικῆς καὶ τῆς ἀσκήσεως πρὸς τὴν αἰώρησιν καὶ τελευταίως πρὸς τὸ φάρμακον.
[Mutating] Ἡ ἀρχὴ τῆς αὐτοκινήσεως μετατίθεται ἀπὸ τὸ σῶμα εἰς τὴν ψυχήν, καὶ ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν ἐξομοίωσιν πρὸς τὸν κόσμον.
[Emergent] Ἡ ὀρθὴ ἀγωγὴ σώματος καὶ ψυχῆς ἀποτελεῖ ἓν σύστημα ἡπίας ἐνεργοποιήσεως καὶ ἐσωτερικῆς ἀνατάξεως.
[Persistent] Ἕκαστον μέρος τοῦ ζῴου ἔχει ἴδιον ῥυθμὸν, ἴδιον πάθος καὶ ἴδιον τρόπον θεραπείας.
[Mutating] Ἡ φυσικὴ τάξις, ἀρχικῶς σωματική, ἀναβαίνει εἰς κοσμικὴν κανονιστικότητα ἣ ὁρίζει τὴν ὀρθὴν παιδείαν.
[Emergent] Ἡ γνώσις θεραπεύει μόνον ὅταν μεταβάλλῃ τὰς ἐσωτερικὰς περιφορὰς τοῦ γνωρίζοντος.
[Terminal] Ἡ ἄριστη ζωή συνίσταται εἰς ἐξομοίωσιν τοῦ νοοῦντος πρὸς τὴν νοουμένην κοσμικὴν τάξιν.
[Attractor] Ἡ θεραπεία ἀποβλέπει εἰς ἁρμονίαν κινήσεων, οὐχὶ εἰς ἀπλὴν ἐξάλειψιν συμπτωμάτων ἢ ἀπαλλαγὴν ἀπὸ τὸ σῶμα.
[Terminal] Ἡ ἀνάγκη περιορίζει τὴν τέχνην, ἐνῶ ἡ παιδαγωγικὴ παρασκευή τοῦ θεραπεύοντος περιορίζει τὴν βίαν.
Ἡ κίνησις ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ὡς σωματικὴ γυμνασία, ψυχικὴ ἄσκησις καὶ κοσμικὴ περιφορά, διατηροῦσα τὸν πυρήνα τῆς ἐνεργοποιήσεως ἀλλὰ μεταβάλλουσα κλίμακα.
Ἡ ἀυτονομία μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ κριτήριον σωματικῆς θεραπείας εἰς ἱκανότητα ψυχικῆς καὶ νοητικῆς ἐξομοιώσεως.
Ἡ ἱεράρχησις τῶν καθάρσεων μετατίθεται εἰς ἱεράρχησιν ψυχικῶν μερῶν, ὥστε ἡ θεραπεία νὰ γίνεται διαφοροποιημένη τροφή καὶ κίνησις.
Ἡ ἔξωθεν ἐπέμβασις, ἣ ἐν τῷ σώματι ἀπορρίπτεται ὡς βιαία, ἀνακωδικοποιεῖται ἐν τῇ ψυχῇ ὡς ἀναγκαία ἐσωτερικὴ ἄσκησις.
Ἡ φύσις ἀπὸ ὁρίζων τοῦ νοσήματος γίνεται πρότυπον τοῦ ἀρίστου βίου καὶ μέτρον τοῦ θείου προσανατολισμοῦ.
Ἡ νόσος καὶ ἡ ψυχικὴ διαφθορά ἐπιτελοῦσι κοινὸν ἀρνητικὸν ἔργον: ἀποκαλύπτουσιν ἀποκλίσεις κινήσεων ἀπὸ τὸν προσήκοντα ῥυθμόν.
Τὰ εἰδικὰ παραδείγματα γυμνασίων, αἰωρήσεων καὶ φαρμάκων μένουσι τοπικὰ, ἐπειδὴ ἡ κειμένη ἀρχὴ εἶναι ἡ βαθμισμένη αὐτονομία τῆς κινήσεως.
Ἡ τριμερὴς διαίρεσις τῆς ψυχῆς εἶναι κατώτερον σχῆμα, ὅπερ κλιμακοῦται εἰς γενικωτέραν ἀρχὴν διαφοροποιημένης θεραπείας.
Ἡ γέφυρα μεταξὺ τῶν δύο κατωτέρων μηχανῶν εἶναι ἡ κίνησις: ἡ σωματικὴ ρύθμισις ἀναλαμβάνεται ὑπὸ τῆς ψυχικῆς ἀγωγῆς.
Ἡ κοσμολογικὴ θεωρία παύει νὰ εἶναι ἁπλὴ διδασκαλία καὶ γίνεται μηχανισμὸς μετασχηματισμοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.
Ἡ ἀντίθεσις φύσεως καὶ τέχνης ὑποχωρεῖ, ἐπειδὴ ἡ τέχνη ἀξιοῦται μόνον ὅταν συνεργῇ τῇ φυσικῇ καὶ κοσμικῇ τάξει.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ θεραπεία ὡς ἀπεριόριστος ἐξωτερικὴ κυριαρχία ἐπὶ σώματος ἢ ψυχῆς.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ὁμοιόμορφος ἀγωγή, ἐπειδὴ ἕκαστον μέρος ἔχει ἴδιον μέτρον κινήσεως καὶ τροφῆς.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἐπιτάχυνσις ὡς αὐτόματον ἀγαθόν, διότι δύναται νὰ διακόψῃ φυσικὸν ἢ ψυχικὸν χρόνον.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ γνώσις ἣ μένει ἀμετάβλητος ἐν τῷ γνωρίζοντι καὶ οὐκ ἐπανορθοῖ τὴν κίνησιν αὐτοῦ.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἀντίληψις τοῦ ζῴου ὡς ἀδρανοῦς ὕλης, ἣν ἡ τέχνη δύναται ἀνευθύνως νὰ μεταπλάττῃ.
Δεῖ ψευδῆ εἶναι τὴν ὑπόθεσιν ὅτι ἡ θεραπεία ὀφείλει πάντοτε νὰ ἐπιβάλλεται ἔξωθεν, ἵνα ἡ ἐσωτερικὴ κίνησις διατηρῆται ὡς κριτήριον.
Δεῖ ψευδῆ εἶναι τὴν ὑπόθεσιν ὅτι ἡ σωματικότης ἐξαντλεῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ψυχὴ ἀναφέρεται εἰς οὐράνιον συγγένειαν.
Δεῖ ψευδῆ εἶναι τὴν ὑπόθεσιν ὅτι ἡ κοσμολογία εἶναι ἀδιάφορος πρὸς τὴν ἀγωγήν, ἐπειδὴ αἱ κοσμικαὶ περιφοραὶ γίνονται κανὼν ἐπανoρθώσεως.
Δεῖ ψευδῆ εἶναι τὴν ὑπόθεσιν ὅτι ἡ γνώσις ἀρκεί ὡς πληροφορία· ἡ γνώσις ὀφείλει νὰ μετασχηματίζῃ τὸ γνωρίζον.
Ἀπουσιάζει κόσμος ἐν ᾧ φύσις, ψυχή, καὶ νόησις εἶναι ἀσύμπτωτοι μηχανισμοί· ἡ δυνατότης θεραπείας ἀπαιτεῖ τὴν συγγένειαν αὐτῶν.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἀπόλυτος αὐτονομία τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, ἐπειδὴ ἡ τελείωσις ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ συμμετοχὴν εἰς προϋπάρχουσαν τάξιν.
Ἡ ἀπούσα δυνατότης τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι θεραπεία ἄνευ μέτρου, χρόνου, ἢ ἐσωτερικῆς μεταβολῆς· ἡ ἰσχὺς τῆς τέχνης ὁρίζεται διὰ τῶν ὁρίων τούτων.
Ἡ σωματικὴ θεραπεία καὶ ἡ ψυχικὴ παιδεία συγκροτοῦσι κοινὸν κανόνα, καθ᾽ ὃν ἡ ὀρθὴ ἐπέμβασις ἐνεργοποιεῖ τὸ θεραπευόμενον ἀντὶ νὰ ἀντικαθιστᾷ τὴν ἐνέργειάν του.
Ἡ διάκρισις φυσικοῦ χρόνου καὶ κοσμικῆς περιφορᾶς παράγει ἕνα ἐνιαῖον θεραπευτικὸν μέτρον, ὅπου ἡ ἐπανόρθωσις ἀπαιτεῖ συγχρονισμόν, οὐχὶ βιαίαν ἐπιτάχυνσιν.
Ἡ φαρμακευτικὴ βία καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμητικὴ ἀταξία ἀναδεικνύονται ὡς παράλληλοι τρόποι ἐξωτερικῆς ἢ ἐσωτερικῆς ἀποσπάσεως ἀπὸ τὸ προσῆκον μέτρον.
Ἡ θεραπεία τοῦ σώματος μεταβάλλεται εἰς θεραπείαν τοῦ τρόπου ᾧ τὸ ὂν ἀντιδρᾷ, ἐπιθυμεῖ, γιγνώσκει καὶ κινείται.
Ἡ ἀνάγκη ἐξωτερικῆς ἐπεμβάσεως οὐ καταλύει τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς αὐτοκινήσεως, ἀλλὰ φανερώνει τὸ ὅριον ἐν ᾧ ἡ τέχνη ὀφείλει νὰ ὑποχωρῇ εἰς τὴν παιδαγωγίαν.
Ἡ ὀντολογία τοῦ ζῴου γίνεται ὀντολογία ρυθμῶν: ὂν ἐστὶ τὸ ὂν ὅσον διατηρεῖ, διορθοῖ καὶ ἀνατάσσει τὰς κινήσεις αὐτοῦ.
Ἡ ἐπιστημολογία μετατρέπεται εἰς θεραπευτικὴν πρακτικήν, ἐπειδὴ τὸ γιγνώσκειν ἀνασχηματίζει τὴν ἐσωτερικὴν κίνησιν τοῦ γνωρίζοντος.
Ἡ ἠθικὴ αὐτονομία δὲν σημαίνει ἀνεξαρτησίαν ἀπὸ τάξιν, ἀλλὰ ἐνεργὸν συμμετοχὴν εἰς τάξιν ἣ ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἔμαθε νὰ ἀναγνωρίζῃ.
Ὁ χρόνος παύει νὰ εἶναι μόνον γραμμὴ φθορᾶς καὶ γίνεται πεδίον ἐπανoρθώσεως, ὅπου ὁ παρὼν βίος συνδέεται πρὸς τὸν ἔπειτα.
Ἡ πολιτικὴ ἢ παιδαγωγικὴ παρέμβασις νομιμοποιεῖται μόνον ὅταν μορφοῖ συνθήκας αὐτορυθμίσεως καὶ οὐχὶ ὅταν πολλαπλασιάζῃ τὴν ἐξάρτησιν.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Ἐσωτερικὴ κίνησις → αὐτονομία → ἁρμονία → ἐνισχυμένη ἐσωτερικὴ κίνησις.
Νόσος ἢ ψυχικὴ διαφθορά → ἀπόκλισις κινήσεων → ἡπία ἀγωγή → ἐπανόρθωσις φυσικοῦ ἢ κοσμικοῦ ῥυθμοῦ.
Ἡ θεραπεία τοῦ σώματος γεννᾷ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς ψυχικῆς θεραπείας, ἡ δὲ ψυχικὴ θεραπεία ἐπιστρέφει καὶ ἐπανανοηματοδοτεῖ τὴν σωματικὴν ἀγωγήν.
Ἡ κοσμικὴ θεωρία γίνεται μηχανή, ὅταν ἡ θέα τῶν περιφορῶν ἐπαναφέρει τὸν νοῦν εἰς τὸν ἑαυτοῦ προσήκοντα κύκλον.
Ὁ κεντρικὸς ἐλκτικὸς πόλος εἶναι ἡ ἐξομοίωσις: ἕκαστη κατώτερη θεραπεία ἀξιολογεῖται ἀπὸ τὸ πόσον προάγει πρὸς ἁρμονικὴν ὁμοιότητα.
