items.text: Systema quaerit quomodo materia, perceptio, vita, historia et calamitas una causalitate naturali comprehendantur, ut terror religiosus et metus mortis sine consolatione transcendente dissolvantur.
Thesis globalis realitatem constituit ut campum corporum primorum in inani, quorum motus, concursus, congruentiae et dissolutiones omnes ordines sensibiles atque sociales producunt.

Argumentatio simul diagnostica, reconstructiva, polemica, genealogica et therapeutica fit, quia falsas attributiones detegit, causas occultas restituit, ordines sine consilio explicat atque affectus reordinat.
Motus manifestus ab effectibus sensibilibus ad principia invisibilia, deinde a compositione ad personam, mundum, historiam et calamitatem biologicam amplificatur.
Motus verus est recursivus: explicatio ad apparentias et affectus redit, dum eadem grammatica materialis per magnitudines maiores cum variatione repetitur.
Directio procedit a concursibus sine consilio ad stabilitates temporarias, inde ad formas viventes, instituta, vulnerabilitatem et dissolutionem.
Clausura duplicatur: mors personae subiectum mali posthumi aufert, pestilentia autem ostendit cognitionem naturalem neque remedium certum neque conservationem ordinis praestare.
Liberatio terminalis immunitatem non promittit; removet interpretationem providentialem et timorem falsum, sed persistentem vulnerabilitatem corporis et societatis servat.
Forma poetica transitum a doctrina difficili ad conversionem affectivam efficit, quia repetitionem causalitatis in actum persuasionis recursivum mutat.
[Persistent] Omnis operatio naturalis, mens et sensus inclusis, in corporibus primis, inani atque motibus corporeis fundatur.
[Persistent] Materia neque producitur ex nihilo neque annihilatur, sed composita quae format permeabilia, mutabilia et mortalia sunt.
[Persistent] Potentiae naturales finitae sunt, quia texturae, semina et compatibilitates determinant quid effici, recipi aut conservari possit.
[Mutating] Configuratio principiorum a causa diversitatis et qualitatum in regulam identitatis, congruentiae et actionis relationalis amplificatur.
[Emergent] Ordo est stabilizatio temporaria inter concursus innumeros, non exemplar antecedens aut dispositio providentialis.
[Emergent] Res, mundi, personae et instituta diversae magnitudinis sunt compositiones locales eiusdem grammaticae ontologicae.
[Mutating] Sensus est fundamentum cognitionis et eventus corporeus verus, dum falsitas ex opinione identitatem, causam aut finem affectioni addente nascitur.
[Emergent] Causae invisibiles ex effectibus sensibilibus inferuntur, quamquam unitas ontologiae pluralitatem mechanismorum particularium admittit.
[Persistent] Dei neque naturam administrant neque usus, aptitudines aut regularitates rerum originarie disponunt.
[Attractor] Ignorantia causalitatis admirationem in attributionem divinam vertit, ratio autem terrorem dissolvit causas intra naturam restituendo.
[Mutating] Persona ex ordinatione temporaria corporis, animi et animae in nodum materialem permeabilem imaginibus, ambiente et institutis mutatur.
[Emergent] Facultates, functiones et instituta structuras non antecedunt, sed ex usu, consuetudine et conservatione retrospectiva emergunt.
[Mutating] Immanentia materialis seriem fataliter clausam interrumpit et ignorantiam causae actualis per possibilitates naturaliter finitas administrat.
[Terminal] Mors personam dissolvit, dum calamitas corpora viventia et ordines sociales sine destinatario morali destruere potest.
[Terminal] Intelligibilitas naturae a dominio practico separatur: cognitio timorem corrigit, sed immunitatem ontologicam non confert.
[Attractor] Sufficientia vitae finitae et tranquillitas ex terminatione cupiditatis atque cognitione finium, non ex favore divino, oriuntur.
Concilium identitatem functionalem servat, sed a re genita ad personam, mundum et configurationem temporaliter stabilem amplificatur.
Qualitas a dependentia corporum in operatorum congruentiam migrat, qui perceptionem, generationem, conservationem et susceptibilitatem morbidam regit.
Sensus a norma epistemica in eventum relationis corporeae mutatur, cui opinio corrigibilis, non ipsa affectio, falsitatem imponit.
Imago a nuntio sensibili in instrumentum dispositionis, attentionis et captationis affectivae transit.
Divinitas a causa naturae removetur, sed nomina divina in figuras affectuum aut exempla pacis non intervenientis transferuntur.
Mortalitas ex dissolutione personae in legem mundorum et demum in facultatem dissolvendi ordines curae, ritus et societatis amplificatur.
Utilitas ex falsa causa originis in effectum usus et genealogiam institutionum mutatur, deinde per arma ac vulnerabilitatem socialem invertitur.
Apertura causalis primo necessitatem absolutam per clinamen limitat, deinde in disciplinam epistemicam pluralitatis causarum migrat.
Vis therapeutica veritatis persistit, sed a fiducia in explicationem ad liberationem sobriam sine promissione dominii mutatur.
Forma poetica rationem non ornat tantum, sed repetitionem cum variatione in mechanismum transmissionis et conversionis affectivae absorbet.
Probationes particulares inanis, minimorum et motuum inferiori gradu manent; hic tantum condiciones compositionis, transmissionis et dissolutionis praebent.
Clinamen et figurae atomicorum localiter motum distinguunt, sed hoc gradu in theoriam differentiae emergentis et agentiae finitae amplificantur.
Anatomia animi et semina morbida machinae locales sunt; definitio personae ut organizationis permeabilis atque dissolubilis ad gradum praesentem pertinet.
Causae particulares motuum caelestium indeterminatae manent, sed earum pluralitas in disciplinam generalem explicationis naturalis convertitur.
Catalogi fabularum et refutationes exemplorum evanescunt opere exclusorio peracto; persistunt fines compatibilitatis et formarum admissibilium.
Contagio inferiori gradu mechanismum morbi explicat; dissolutio institutionum et mortalitas ordinis socialis sunt effectus totius libri.
Status materialis deorum non plene restituitur; praesentis gradus structura eorum gubernationem tantum excludit atque immortalitatem cum lege compositorum in tensione relinquit.
Ars poetica localiter doctrinam tractabilem reddit, sed hoc gradu fit modus performativus quo causalitas repetita persuasionem producit.
Transitus a cosmologia ad anthropologiam et a perceptione ad pestilentiam in unam ontologiam materialem magnitudine variantem coniungitur.
Systema neque creationem absolutam neque annihilationem neque animam incorpoream dissolutioni corporis superstitem admittit.
Providentia, finalitas et administratio mundi ad usum humanum tamquam causae originis excluduntur.
Principia ultima qualitates sensibiles non continent, sicut futura utilitas formam organi vel institutionis originarie causare non potest.
Apparentia sensibilis inventarium completum realitatis non est, sed nullum tribunal cognitionis sensibus et naturae extrinsecum conceditur.
Mundus, locus et homo privilegium cosmicum non possident neque finis processus naturalis constituuntur.
Opes, honores, mutatio loci et progressus technicus causam perturbationis non tollunt neque felicitatem necessario augent.
Distributio calamitatum neque meritum sequitur neque ordinem physicum in iudicium morale convertit.
Explicatio naturalis promissionem remedii, tutelae, immunitatis aut dominii universalis non continet.
Inferi posthumi et mors tamquam experientia personae excluduntur, quia dissolutio ipsum campum experientiae aufert.
Ignorantia causae testimonium numinis esse non potest; aliter ipsa absentia explicationis in probationem gubernationis converteretur.
Regularitas neque intentionem ordinatricem neque necessitatem causaliter clausam probare potest.
Identitas et stabilitas localis substantiam permanentem non requirunt, sed ordinationem selectivam et continuitatem operationum.
Naturalitas explicationis a certitudine unius causae actualis separanda est, quia eventus relationis certior quam mechanismus singularis esse potest.
Securitas per fugam, accumulationem aut possessionem plenam acquiri non potest, quia cupiditas et perturbatio mediatione recursiva renovantur.
Causa naturalis effectum benignum, coercibilem aut remedio tractabilem facere non debet; aliter cognitio in promissionem immunitatis mutaretur.
Ordo physicus iudicium morale exprimere non potest, quia calamitas causas et victimas habet sine destinatario metaphysico.
Vis poetica invocationis divinae testimonium interventionis esse non potest, quamquam status deorum extra machinam materialem imperfecte determinatur.
Indisponibilis est omnis exterior: nullus creator, receptaculum aut locus cognitionis extra naturam totum campum ordinat vel iudicat.
Indisponibilis est destinatarius privilegiatus cui mundus referatur aut cui providentia immunitatem ontologicam concedat.
Indisponibilis est finis universalis cosmicus vel historicus; permanent redistributiones et successiones sine perfectione necessaria.
Indisponibilis est prospectus personalis qui dissolutionem suam superet atque propriam non-exsistentiam observet.
Indisponibiles sunt clausura epistemica totalis et dominium practicum, etiam ubi causalitas materialis firmiter constituitur.
Totum inter duas absentias terminales ordinatur: mors patientem posthumum non habet, pestilentia iudicem moralem non habet.
Cum eadem grammatica res, mundos et personas constituat atque composita porosa sint, identitas fit stabilitas commutationis terminatae, non possessio materiae immutabilis.
Conservatio materiae consolationem personalem non praebet, quia eadem redistributio quae materiam servat personas, mundos et ordines irreversibiliter dissolvit.
Clinamen et pluralitas causarum efficiunt immanentiam simul ontologice apertam et epistemice finitam, sine recursu ad voluntatem supernaturalem.
Affectus est eventus materialis verus, sed captatio nascitur cum opinio fontem commotionis falso obiecto tribuit atque attentionem recursive figit.
Cum ordo post concursus stabilitur et functio structuram sequitur, apparentia consilii fit memoria retrospectiva conservationis, non causa originis.
Pestilentia ontologiae non opponitur, sed legem mortalitatis compositorum a corpore ad officia, ritus et societatem amplificat.
Distinctio inter mortem et calamitatem ethicam therapiam terminat: non-experientia posthuma timorem falsum aufert, sed vulnerabilitas praesentis corporis malum reale relinquit.
Religio terrifica ex actione deorum non oritur, sed ex imaginibus et nominibus divinis quae attentionem, timorem et attributionem causaliter errantem stabilizant.
Efficacia cognitionis est imprimis discriminativa: causas naturales restringit, attributionem divinam excludit et affectum reordinat, quamquam eventum neque praedicit perfecte neque coercet.
Finitae potentiae naturae fundamentum ethicum fiunt, quia sufficientia non ex possessione infinita sed ex cognitione terminorum desiderii et actionis provenit.
Repetitio poetica structuram ipsius naturae imitatur: eadem grammatica per campos varios transit, differentias servat et conversionem affectivam per iterationem producit.
Realitas est hierarchia sine centro stabilizationum inclusarum, sed syntaxis differentiae, fluxus, congruentiae et dissolutionis invarians magnitudine manet.
Tempus distribuitur inter motum aeternum principiorum, durationem finitam compositorum, successionem irreversibilem historiae et absentiam temporis personaliter experti post mortem.
Subiectum est nodus corporeus temporarius et permeabilis, cuius identitas ex limite commutationum, memoria et ordinatione sensifera, non ex clausura substantiali, provenit.
Epistemologia totius est realismus asymmetricalis: genera causarum et fines potestatum cognosci possunt, dum mechanismus actualis singularis interdum indeterminatus manet.
Potestas politica et instituta non habent originem sovereignam, sed sunt amplificationes sociales metus, utilitatis, consuetudinis et vulnerabilitatis compositorum.
Libertas neque exemptio a natura neque necessitas mera est, sed facultas localis circuitus attentionis, opinionis et timoris intra causalitatem materialem interrumpendi.
Ethica totius distinguit inter malum imaginarium mortis posthumae et mala praesentia corporis vulnerabilis; primum cognitione tollitur, altera ontologice permanent.
Clausura pestilentialis doctrinam materialem confirmat recusando iudicium providentiale, sed simul promissionem liberationis ad correctionem timoris restringit.
Methodus totius est performativa: doctrina causalitatis non tantum exponitur, sed per formam poeticam, recursum et variationem in habitum interpretandi convertitur.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Ignorantia causae → attributio intentionis → terror → observatio anxia → renovata ignorantia constituit circuitum religiosum auto-confirmantem.
Effectus sensibilis → causa invisibilis restricta → apparentia reclassificata → novum indicium constituit circuitum inquisitivum qui cognitionem cumulativam generat.
Compositio → stabilizatio → proprietas emergens → dissolutio → materia novis concursibus reddita constituit circuitum conservationis sine identitate formarum.
Imago → attentio → cupiditas vel timor → opinio idealizans → plures imagines constituit circuitum communem captationis eroticae et religiosae.
Structura utilis → consuetudo → institutum → opes → ambitio → arma → vulnerabilitas collectivam escalationem progressus ambivalentis producit.
Metus mortis → ambitio → potentia → violentia → productio mortis → metus amplificatus est via catastrophica compensationis.
Ratio naturae → cognitio potentiarum finitarum → remotio causae divinae → imminutio timoris → attentio renovata ad naturam constituit attractorem therapeuticum.
Cura → propinquitas → contagio et fuga → desertio → mors efficiunt duplicem clausuram tragicam in qua officium nullo itinere immunitatem praestat.
Attractor terminalis est finitas potentiarum: inquisitio mechanismos restringit, actio intra naturam manet et timor sine dominio totali minuitur.

items.text: Ignorantia causalitatis → falsa aestimatio → attributio divina → terror religiosus et mortis → quaestio de natura.
Corpora prima + inane + motus → campus ontologicus sufficiens omnibus rebus operantibus sine tertia natura.
Pondus + plagae + clinamen + potentiae finitae → causalitas immanens neque providentialis neque fataliter exhausta.
Semina certa + differentiae texturarum + congruentia selectiva → generationes finitae et commercia determinata.
Concursus innumeri + configuratio → stabilitas temporaria → qualitates, vita, mundi et identitates emergentes.
Compositum permeabile + effluxus + receptio selectiva → sensus, memoria, actio et vulnerabilitas ambientaliter mediata.
Affectio + opinio addita + attentio repetita → falsa identitas causae → cupiditas, religio et circuitus compensatorii.
Structura nata + usus + consuetudo + conflictus → facultates, vocabula, leges et instituta sine auctore originario.
Dissolutio configurationis → mors personae / mundi / institutionis → materia conservata + forma irreversibiliter amissa.
Reconstructio causalis → exclusio providentiae → correctio opinionis → imminutio timoris, sed non remedium universale aut dominium naturae.

sections.original_name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Effectus sensibilis → principia corporea invisibilia → motus et concursus → configuratio selectiva → proprietates emergentes → composita permeabilia → dissolutio per omnes magnitudines.
Ignorantia causae → religio et metus mortis → inquisitio naturalis → remotio providentiae → mortalitas personae → correctio affectus → tranquillitas finita.
Stabilitas sine consilio → vita et utilitas → consuetudo atque instituta → opes et arma → vulnerabilitas communis → pestilentia → distinctio terminalis inter intelligibilitatem et dominium.
Oppositio inter visibile et reale reordinatur: invisibilitas causae methodum inferentialem requirit, non exclusionem a cognitione.
Qualitates, sensus et identitates ex proprietatibus simplicibus substantiarum in effectus relationum, texturarum et configurationum transferuntur.
Ordo et functio a consilio antecedente separantur atque in stabilitatem post concursus et conservationem retrospectivam reclassificantur.
Subiectum ex centro immateriali in nodum permeabilem circulationis corporum, imaginum, affectuum et institutionum mutatur.
Oppositio inter providentiam et fatum corruit, quia immanentia materialis contingentiam limitatam et pluralitatem causaliter restrictam continet.
Progressus technicus ex incremento necessario boni in amplificatorem commodorum, desideriorum, belli et vulnerabilitatis convertitur.
Cognitio naturae ab imperio separatur, quia eius effectus proprius est reordinatio interpretationis et timoris, non tutela universalis.
Mors et calamitas in eadem ontologia sed non eadem ethica locantur: mors subiectum tollit, calamitas subiecta viventia vulnerat.
Pietas et naturalismus non iam opponuntur, quia pax divina per exclusionem gubernationis et interventionis causaliter servatur.
In gradu superficiei principia rerum, sensus, metus, imagines, mundi, origines vitae, historia, morbi et pestilentia ut obiecta continuae explicationis apparent.
In gradu structurali corpora, inane, motus, effluxus, texturas, congruentiae et dissolutiones diversas operationes in unam causalitatem materialem distribuunt.
In gradu metastrategico certamen contra deos, fatum et mortem in correctionem opinionum, definitionem finium et interruptionem circuituum affectivorum convertitur.
In gradu ontologico et temporali materia manet, composita durant et pereunt, subiecta nodi finiti sunt, historia autem status irreversibiles accumulat.
In gradu methodologico et performativo carmen, analogia et probatio cumulativa eandem grammaticam per variationes repetunt atque affectum in cognitionem causaliter ordinatam traducunt.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Sensus fundamentum probationis manet, quamquam causae ultimae inspectionem directam excedunt et transitus ad eas analogia firmatur.
Leges compatibilitatis stabilitatem generant, sed clinamen et casus eventum aperiunt; mensura inter necessitatem et contingentiam incompleta manet.
Sensus ex principiis insensilibus emergere debet, sed transitus a figura et motu ad veritatem affectionis mechanice non absolvitur.
Immortalitas deorum cum lege dissolutionis compositorum non plene cohaeret, quia dei remoti in machina materiali imperfecte derivantur.
Invocatio poetica Veneris vim agendi retinet, dum pietas doctrinalis pacem divinam per non-interventionem conservat.
Exclusio causae divinae firmior est quam electio mechanismi naturalis singularis, unde certitudo therapeutica indeterminationem explicativam superat.
Promissio purificationis animi cum persistentia pestilentiali comprimitur: cognitio timorem corrigit, sed conservationem corporis aut societatis non praestat.
Conservatio principiorum cum irreversibilitate formarum componitur, sed haec distinctio materiam aeternam ab historia amissionum acute dividit.
Qualitas ex accidente dependenti in congruentiam relationalem mutatur, quae generationem, viabilitatem et susceptibilitatem ordinat.
Identitas ex continuitate organizationis in nodum permeabilem commutationum corporearum et socialium amplificatur.
Simulacrum a nuntio formae in operatorem recursivum cupiditatis, memoriae, attentionis et religionis mutatur.
Ordo ex consecutione recurrente in configurationem temporaliter stabilem mutatur, cui dissolutio iam intrinseca est.
Mortalitas ab eventu logico qui subiectum nocendi tollit in potestatem cosmologicam et socialem dissolvendi ordines amplificatur.
Pietas ab obsequio rituali in conservationem pacis divinae per exclusionem interventionis mutatur.
Therapia a fiducia in explicationem plenam ad liberationem finitam mutatur, quae timorem tollit sine promissione dominii.

sections.original_name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Realitas implicite est campus infinitus et porosus corporum mobilium, qui nodos locales format, per eos fluit et eos tandem dissolvit.
Subiectum est nodus corporeus temporarius, simul receptor selectivus et distributio motuum, non centrum immateriale aut clausum.
Tempus est permanentia principiorum sub successione irreversibili formarum; composita durationem habent, persona autem propriam absentiam non experitur.
Certamen principale opponit circuitus captationis, qui imaginem et ignorantiam se ipsas alunt, cognitioni quae causas, attentionem et attributionem convertit.
Navigatio possibilis est motus intra naturam sine exteriori, quo timor minuitur sine immunitate et actio exercetur sine dominio totali.
Axiomata praesentia sufficiunt ad restituendam machinam a materia conservata et motu per perceptionem, emergentiam et historiam ad mortalitatem personalem atque pestilentiam.
Structura firmissima est coniunctio conservationis materiae, causalitatis invarianti magnitudine, mortalitatis compositorum et correctionis attributionis divinae.
Minus determinati manent nexus a clinamine ad voluntatem, a principiis insensilibus ad sensum et a possibilitate analogica ad mechanismum actualem.
Systema cohaeret quia motum ab affectu ad physicam, a concursu ad ordinem, ab ignorantia ad timorem et ab explicatione ad limites imperii servat.
Cohaerentia pendet ex distinctione principiorum permanentium a configurationibus temporalibus atque ex analogiis quae hiatus inter magnitudines transponunt.
Tensionem inter liberationem animi et vulnerabilitatem corporis eliminare non licet, quia ipsa extensionem therapiam a promissione metaphysica distinguit.
Reductioni axiomaticae resistit vis performativa carminis, quae doctrinam obscuram per repetitionem causalitatis in conversionem affectivam traducit.

The system asks how matter, perception, life, history, and calamity may be comprehended within a single natural causality, so that religious terror and fear of death may be dissolved without transcendent consolation.
The global thesis constitutes reality as a field of primary bodies in the void, whose motions, collisions, congruities, and dissolutions produce all sensible and social orders.

The argument becomes simultaneously diagnostic, reconstructive, polemical, genealogical, and therapeutic, because it detects false attributions, restores hidden causes, explains orders without design, and reorders affects.
The manifest movement extends from sensible effects to invisible principles, then from composition to the person, the world, history, and biological calamity.
The real movement is recursive: explanation returns to appearances and affects, while the same material grammar is repeated with variation across larger scales.
The direction proceeds from undesigned collisions to temporary stabilities, thence to living forms, institutions, vulnerability, and dissolution.
The closure is doubled: the death of the person removes the subject of posthumous evil, whereas plague shows that natural knowledge provides neither a certain remedy nor preservation of order.
Terminal liberation does not promise immunity; it removes providential interpretation and false fear, but retains the persistent vulnerability of body and society.
Poetic form effects the passage from difficult doctrine to affective conversion, because it turns the repetition of causality into a recursive act of persuasion.
[Persistent] Every natural operation, including mind and sensation, is founded on primary bodies, void, and bodily motions.
[Persistent] Matter is neither produced from nothing nor annihilated, but composes entities whose forms are permeable, mutable, and mortal.
[Persistent] Natural powers are finite, because textures, seeds, and compatibilities determine what can be effected, received, or preserved.
[Mutating] The configuration of principles is extended from a cause of diversity and qualities into a rule of identity, congruity, and relational action.
[Emergent] Order is a temporary stabilization among innumerable collisions, not an antecedent model or providential arrangement.
[Emergent] Things, worlds, persons, and institutions of diverse scales are local compositions of the same ontological grammar.
[Mutating] Sensation is the foundation of knowledge and a true bodily event, while falsity arises from opinion adding identity, cause, or end to an affection.
[Emergent] Invisible causes are inferred from sensible effects, although the unity of ontology admits a plurality of particular mechanisms.
[Persistent] The gods neither govern nature nor originally arrange the uses, capacities, or regularities of things.
[Attractor] Ignorance of causality turns wonder into divine attribution, whereas reason dissolves terror by restoring causes within nature.
[Mutating] The person is transformed from a temporary ordering of body, mind, and soul into a material node permeable to images, environment, and institutions.
[Emergent] Faculties, functions, and institutions do not precede structures, but emerge from use, custom, and retrospective preservation.
[Mutating] Material immanence interrupts a fatally closed series and manages ignorance of the actual cause through naturally finite possibilities.
[Terminal] Death dissolves the person, while calamity can destroy living bodies and social orders without a moral addressee.
[Terminal] The intelligibility of nature is separated from practical mastery: knowledge corrects fear, but does not confer ontological immunity.
[Attractor] The sufficiency of finite life and tranquillity arise from the termination of desire and knowledge of limits, not from divine favor.
Design retains functional identity, but is extended from a generated thing to the person, the world, and a temporally stable configuration.
Quality migrates from the dependence of bodies into the congruity of operators, which governs perception, generation, preservation, and susceptibility to disease.
Sensation changes from an epistemic norm into an event of bodily relation, upon which corrigible opinion, not the affection itself, imposes falsity.
The image passes from a sensible message into an instrument of disposition, attention, and affective captivation.
Divinity is removed as a cause of nature, but divine names are transferred into figures of affects or examples of non-intervening peace.
Mortality is extended from the dissolution of the person into a law of worlds and finally into a capacity to dissolve the orders of care, ritual, and society.
Utility changes from a false cause of origin into an effect of use and a genealogy of institutions, then is inverted through arms and social vulnerability.
Causal openness first limits absolute necessity through clinamen, then migrates into an epistemic discipline of a plurality of causes.
The therapeutic force of truth persists, but changes from confidence in explanation to sober liberation without a promise of mastery.
Poetic form does not merely adorn reason, but absorbs repetition with variation into a mechanism of transmission and affective conversion.
Particular proofs of void, minima, and motions remain at the lower level; here they provide only conditions of composition, transmission, and dissolution.
Clinamen and the figures of atoms locally distinguish motion, but at this level are extended into a theory of emergent difference and finite agency.
The anatomy of mind and seeds of disease are local mechanisms; the definition of the person as permeable and dissoluble organization belongs to the present level.
The particular causes of celestial motions remain indeterminate, but their plurality is converted into a general discipline of natural explanation.
Catalogues of fables and refutations of examples vanish once their exclusionary work has been completed; limits of compatibility and admissible forms persist.
Contagion explains the mechanism of disease at the lower level; the dissolution of institutions and mortality of social order are effects of the whole book.
The material status of the gods is not fully restored; the structure of the present level only excludes their governance and leaves immortality in tension with the law of composites.
Poetic art locally renders doctrine tractable, but at this level becomes a performative mode by which repeated causality produces persuasion.
The passage from cosmology to anthropology and from perception to plague is joined in a single material ontology varying by scale.
The system admits neither absolute creation nor annihilation nor an incorporeal soul surviving the dissolution of the body.
Providence, finality, and governance of the world for human use are excluded as causes of origin.
Ultimate principles do not contain sensible qualities, just as future utility cannot originally cause the form of an organ or institution.
Sensible appearance is not a complete inventory of reality, but no tribunal of knowledge extrinsic to the senses and nature is granted.
The world, place, and human being possess no cosmic privilege, nor are they constituted as the end of natural process.
Wealth, honors, change of place, and technical progress neither remove the cause of disturbance nor necessarily increase happiness.
The distribution of calamities neither follows merit nor converts physical order into moral judgment.
Natural explanation contains no promise of remedy, protection, immunity, or universal mastery.
Posthumous underworlds and death as an experience of the person are excluded, because dissolution removes the very field of experience.
Ignorance of a cause cannot be evidence of divinity; otherwise the very absence of explanation would be converted into proof of governance.
Regularity can prove neither ordering intention nor causally closed necessity.
Local identity and stability do not require a permanent substance, but selective ordering and continuity of operations.
The naturalness of explanation must be separated from certainty about a single actual cause, because an event of relation can be more certain than a singular mechanism.
Security cannot be acquired through flight, accumulation, or full possession, because desire and disturbance are renewed through recursive mediation.
A natural cause need not make its effect benign, controllable, or treatable by remedy; otherwise knowledge would be changed into a promise of immunity.
Physical order cannot express moral judgment, because calamity has causes and victims without a metaphysical addressee.
The poetic force of divine invocation cannot be evidence of intervention, although the status of the gods outside the material machine is imperfectly determined.
Every exterior is unavailable: no creator, receptacle, or site of knowledge outside nature orders or judges the whole field.
Unavailable is a privileged addressee to whom the world is referred or to whom providence grants ontological immunity.
Unavailable is a universal cosmic or historical end; redistributions and successions persist without necessary perfection.
Unavailable is a personal perspective that surpasses its own dissolution and observes its own non-existence.
Total epistemic closure and practical mastery are unavailable, even where material causality is firmly established.
The whole is ordered between two terminal absences: death has no posthumous sufferer; plague has no moral judge.
Since the same grammar constitutes things, worlds, and persons, and composites are porous, identity becomes the stability of bounded exchange, not possession of immutable matter.
The conservation of matter provides no personal consolation, because the same redistribution that preserves matter irreversibly dissolves persons, worlds, and orders.
Clinamen and the plurality of causes make immanence simultaneously ontologically open and epistemically finite, without recourse to supernatural will.
Affect is a true material event, but captivation arises when opinion falsely attributes the source of disturbance to an object and recursively fixes attention.
When order stabilizes after collisions and function follows structure, the appearance of design becomes a retrospective memory of preservation, not a cause of origin.
Plague does not oppose ontology, but extends the law of mortality of composites from the body to offices, rites, and society.
The distinction between death and calamity terminates ethical therapy: posthumous non-experience removes false fear, but the vulnerability of the present body leaves real evil.
Terrifying religion does not arise from the action of gods, but from divine images and names that stabilize attention, fear, and causally erroneous attribution.
The efficacy of knowledge is primarily discriminative: it restricts natural causes, excludes divine attribution, and reorders affect, although it neither perfectly predicts nor controls the event.
The finite powers of nature become an ethical foundation, because sufficiency arises not from infinite possession but from knowledge of the limits of desire and action.
Poetic repetition imitates the structure of nature itself: the same grammar passes through diverse fields, preserves differences, and produces affective conversion through iteration.
Reality is a centerless hierarchy of nested stabilizations, but the syntax of difference, flux, congruity, and dissolution remains invariant across scale.
Time is distributed among the eternal motion of principles, the finite duration of composites, the irreversible succession of history, and the absence of personally experienced time after death.
The subject is a temporary and permeable bodily node, whose identity arises from the limit of exchanges, memory, and sensory ordering, not from substantial closure.
The epistemology of the whole is asymmetrical realism: kinds of causes and limits of powers can be known, while the singular actual mechanism sometimes remains indeterminate.
Political power and institutions have no sovereign origin, but are social amplifications of fear, utility, custom, and the vulnerability of composites.
Freedom is neither exemption from nature nor mere necessity, but a local capacity to interrupt circuits of attention, opinion, and fear within material causality.

The ethics of the whole distinguishes between the imaginary evil of posthumous death and the present evils of the vulnerable body; the former is removed by knowledge, the latter persist ontologically.
The pestilential closure confirms material doctrine by rejecting providential judgment, but simultaneously restricts the promise of liberation to the correction of fear.
The method of the whole is performative: the doctrine of causality is not merely expounded, but transformed through poetic form, recurrence, and variation into a habit of interpreting.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Ignorance of cause → attribution of intention → terror → anxious observation → renewed ignorance constitutes a self-confirming religious circuit.
Sensible effect → restricted invisible cause → reclassified appearance → new indication constitutes an investigative circuit that generates cumulative knowledge.
Composition → stabilization → emergent property → dissolution → matter returned to new collisions constitutes a circuit of conservation without identity of forms.
Image → attention → desire or fear → idealizing opinion → more images constitutes a common circuit of erotic and religious captivation.
Useful structure → custom → institution → wealth → ambition → arms → vulnerability produces a collective escalation of ambivalent progress.
Fear of death → ambition → power → violence → production of death → amplified fear is a catastrophic path of compensation.
Reason concerning nature → knowledge of finite powers → removal of divine cause → diminution of fear → renewed attention to nature constitutes a therapeutic attractor.
Care → proximity → contagion and flight → abandonment → death effect a double tragic closure in which duty provides immunity by no path.
The terminal attractor is the finitude of powers: inquiry restricts mechanisms, action remains within nature, and fear diminishes without total mastery.

sections.original_name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Ignorance of causality → false estimation → divine attribution → religious and deathly terror → inquiry into nature.
Primary bodies + void + motion → an ontological field sufficient for all operating things without a third nature.
Weight + impacts + clinamen + finite powers → immanent causality neither providential nor fatally exhausted.
Determinate seeds + differences of textures + selective congruity → finite generations and determinate interactions.
Innumerable collisions + configuration → temporary stability → emergent qualities, life, worlds, and identities.
Permeable composite + efflux + selective reception → sensation, memory, action, and environmentally mediated vulnerability.
Affection + added opinion + repeated attention → false identity of cause → desire, religion, and compensatory circuits.
Born structure + use + custom + conflict → faculties, vocabularies, laws, and institutions without an original author.
Dissolution of configuration → death of person / world / institution → matter conserved + form irreversibly lost.
Causal reconstruction → exclusion of providence → correction of opinion → diminution of fear, but not universal remedy or mastery of nature.

sections.original_name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Sensible effect → invisible bodily principles → motions and collisions → selective configuration → emergent properties → permeable composites → dissolution across all scales.
Ignorance of cause → religion and fear of death → natural inquiry → removal of providence → mortality of the person → correction of affect → finite tranquillity.
Stability without design → life and utility → custom and institutions → wealth and arms → common vulnerability → plague → terminal distinction between intelligibility and mastery.
The opposition between visible and real is reordered: the invisibility of cause requires an inferential method, not exclusion from knowledge.
Qualities, sensations, and identities are transferred from simple properties of substances into effects of relations, textures, and configurations.
Order and function are separated from antecedent design and reclassified into post-collision stability and retrospective preservation.
The subject changes from an immaterial center into a permeable node of the circulation of bodies, images, affects, and institutions.
The opposition between providence and fate collapses, because material immanence contains limited contingency and causally restricted plurality.
Technical progress is converted from a necessary increase of good into an amplifier of conveniences, desires, war, and vulnerability.
Knowledge of nature is separated from rule, because its proper effect is the reordering of interpretation and fear, not universal protection.
Death and calamity are placed in the same ontology but not the same ethics: death removes the subject, calamity wounds living subjects.
Piety and naturalism no longer stand opposed, because divine peace is causally preserved through the exclusion of governance and intervention.
At the surface level, the principles of things, sensation, fear, images, worlds, the origins of life, history, diseases, and plague appear as objects of continuous explanation.
At the structural level, bodies, void, motion, effluxes, textures, congruities, and dissolutions distribute diverse operations within a single material causality.
At the metastrategic level, the struggle against gods, fate, and death is converted into correction of opinions, definition of limits, and interruption of affective circuits.
At the ontological and temporal level, matter remains, composites endure and perish, subjects are finite nodes, whereas history accumulates irreversible states.
At the methodological and performative level, poem, analogy, and cumulative proof repeat the same grammar through variations and carry affect into causally ordered knowledge.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Sensation remains the foundation of proof, although ultimate causes exceed direct inspection and the transition to them is supported by analogy.
Laws of compatibility generate stability, but clinamen and chance open events; the measure between necessity and contingency remains incomplete.
Sensation must emerge from insensible principles, but the transition from figure and motion to the truth of affection is not mechanically resolved.
The immortality of the gods does not fully cohere with the law of dissolution of composites, because remote gods are imperfectly derived within the material machine.
The poetic invocation of Venus retains agency, while doctrinal piety preserves divine peace through non-intervention.
The exclusion of divine cause is stronger than the selection of a singular natural mechanism, whence therapeutic certainty surpasses explanatory indetermination.
The promise of purification of the mind is compressed by pestilential persistence: knowledge corrects fear, but does not provide preservation of body or society.
The conservation of principles is joined with the irreversibility of forms, but this distinction sharply divides eternal matter from the history of losses.
Quality changes from a dependent accident into relational congruity, which orders generation, viability, and susceptibility.
Identity is extended from continuity of organization into a permeable node of bodily and social exchanges.
The simulacrum changes from a message of form into a recursive operator of desire, memory, attention, and religion.
Order changes from recurrent sequence into a temporally stable configuration, to which dissolution is already intrinsic.
Mortality is extended from a logical event that removes the subject of harm into a cosmological and social power to dissolve orders.
Piety changes from ritual obedience into the preservation of divine peace through the exclusion of intervention.
Therapy changes from confidence in full explanation into finite liberation, which removes fear without a promise of mastery.

sections.original_name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Reality is implicitly an infinite and porous field of moving bodies, which forms local nodes, flows through them, and finally dissolves them.
The subject is a temporary bodily node, at once a selective receiver and a distribution of motions, not an immaterial or closed center.
Time is the permanence of principles under the irreversible succession of forms; composites have duration, whereas the person does not experience its own absence.
The principal struggle opposes circuits of captivation, in which image and ignorance nourish themselves, to knowledge that converts causes, attention, and attribution.
Possible navigation is motion within nature without an exterior, by which fear is diminished without immunity and action is exercised without total mastery.
The present axioms suffice to reconstruct the machine from conserved matter and motion, through perception, emergence, and history, to personal mortality and plague.
The firmest structure is the conjunction of conservation of matter, causality invariant across scale, mortality of composites, and correction of divine attribution.
Less determined remain the links from clinamen to will, from insensible principles to sensation, and from analogical possibility to actual mechanism.
The system coheres because it retains the movement from affect to physics, from collision to order, from ignorance to fear, and from explanation to the limits of rule.
Coherence depends on the distinction of permanent principles from temporal configurations and on analogies that bridge gaps between scales.
The tension between liberation of the mind and vulnerability of the body must not be eliminated, because it itself distinguishes therapy's extension from a metaphysical promise.
The performative force of the poem resists axiomatic reduction, conveying obscure doctrine through repetition of causality into affective conversion.
